  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(e."Examination Date", p.birthday))::int AS age,
  p.diagnosis
FROM public.examination AS e
JOIN public.patient AS p ON p.id = e.id
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = e.id
WHERE l.hgb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l.hgb DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e."aCL IgM"
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.examination AS e ON e.id = p.id
WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.description = DATE '1994-02-19'
  AND e."Examination Date" = DATE '1993-11-12';

SELECT
  (
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.date >= DATE '1981-11-01' AND l.date < DATE '1981-12-01' THEN l."T-CHO" END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN l.date >= DATE '1981-12-01' AND l.date < DATE '1982-01-01' THEN l."T-CHO" END)
  )::numeric
  / NULLIF(
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.date >= DATE '1981-12-01' AND l.date < DATE '1982-01-01' THEN l."T-CHO" END),
    0
  ) AS decrease_rate
FROM public.patient p
JOIN public.laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.birthday = DATE '1959-02-18';

SELECT DISTINCT l.id
FROM public.laboratory AS l
WHERE l.date BETWEEN DATE '1987-07-06' AND DATE '1996-01-31'
  AND l.gpt > 30
  AND l.alb < 4
ORDER BY l.id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id)
FROM public.examination AS e
WHERE e.thrombosis = 2
  AND e."ANA Pattern" = 'S'
  AND e."aCL IgM" > (
    SELECT AVG("aCL IgM") + AVG("aCL IgM") * 0.2
    FROM public.examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT p.id
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.admission = '-'
  AND l.date >= DATE '1991-10-01'
  AND l.date < DATE '1991-11-01'
  AND l."T-BIL" < 2.0;

SELECT AVG(l.alb)
FROM public.laboratory AS l
JOIN public.patient AS p ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND l.plt > 400
  AND p.diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_aps_patients
FROM public.patient
WHERE sex = 'F'
  AND diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage_women
FROM public.patient
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM birthday) = 1980
  AND diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT DISTINCT p.id
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'M'
  AND l.gpt >= 60;

SELECT p.diagnosis
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.gpt > 60
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.sex, p.birthday
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.un = 29;

SELECT
  p.sex,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.id::text, ', ' ORDER BY p.id) AS patient_ids
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.sex
ORDER BY p.sex;

SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)) AS average_age
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'M'
  AND l."T-CHO" >= 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.tg >= 200
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) > 50;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.birthday BETWEEN DATE '1936-01-01' AND DATE '1956-12-31'
  AND p.sex = 'M'
  AND l.cpk >= 250;

SELECT p.id, p.sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)::int AS age
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.glu >= 180
  AND l."T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT
  p.id,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)::int AS age,
  p.diagnosis
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.rbc < 3.5;

SELECT p.id, p.sex
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.hgb > 10
  AND l.hgb < 17
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  p.id,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)::int AS age
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.hct >= 52
GROUP BY p.id, p.birthday
HAVING COUNT(l.id) > 2;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.plt < 100 THEN l.id END) AS lower_than_normal_patients,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.plt > 400 THEN l.id END) AS higher_than_normal_patients,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.plt < 100 THEN l.id END)
    - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.plt > 400 THEN l.id END) AS difference
FROM public.laboratory AS l
WHERE l.plt <= 100 OR l.plt >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT p.id
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON l.id = p.id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1984
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) < 50
  AND l.plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.sex = 'F' AND l.pt >= 14)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.pt >= 14), 0) AS percentage_female
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON l.id = p.id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) > 55;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'M'
  AND l.wbc > 3.5
  AND l.wbc < 9.0
  AND (l.fg <= 150 OR l.fg >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS patients_with_symptoms
FROM public.examination AS e
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = e.id
WHERE l.igg > 900
  AND l.igg < 2000
  AND e.symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.iga > 80
  AND l.iga < 500
  AND p."First Date" >= DATE '1990-01-01';

SELECT diagnosis
FROM public.patient p
JOIN public.laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.igm <= 40 OR l.igm >= 400
GROUP BY diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM public.patient p
JOIN public.laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.crp = '+'
  AND p.description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)
FROM public.laboratory AS l
JOIN public.patient AS p ON p.id = l.id
WHERE l.cre >= 1.5
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON p.id = l.id
WHERE l.rnp IN ('-', '+-')
  AND p.admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id)
FROM public.examination AS e
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON e.id = l.id
WHERE l.sm IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
JOIN public.examination AS e ON e.id = p.id
WHERE l.sc170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.sex = 'F'
  AND e.symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'M'
  AND l.centromea IN ('-', '+-')
  AND l.ssb IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT MAX(p.birthday) AS youngest_birth_date
FROM public.patient AS p
JOIN public.laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.got >= 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id)
FROM public.examination AS e
JOIN public.laboratory AS l
  ON e.id = l.id
WHERE l.cpk < 250
  AND (
    e.kct = '+'
    OR e.rvvt = '+'
    OR e.lac = '+'
  );

SELECT l.name
FROM public.league AS l
JOIN public.match AS m ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(m.home_team_goal, 0) + COALESCE(m.away_team_goal, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM public.match AS m
JOIN public.league AS l
  ON l.id = m.league_id
JOIN public.team AS t
  ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2009/2010'
  AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  t.team_long_name,
  MAX(ta.buildupplayspeed) AS max_build_up_play_speed
FROM public.team AS t
JOIN public.team_attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.buildupplayspeed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY max_build_up_play_speed DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT l.name
FROM public.league AS l
JOIN public.match AS m ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  p.player_name,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, TO_DATE(p.birthday, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS age
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(pa.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015;

SELECT
  l.name AS league_name,
  COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM public.match AS m
JOIN public.league AS l
  ON l.id = m.league_id
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id
FROM public.team_attributes
WHERE buildupplayspeed > 50
  AND buildupplayspeed < 60;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM public.team AS t
JOIN public.team_attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ta.date::date) = 2012
  AND ta.buildupplaypassing > (
    SELECT SUM(ta2.buildupplaypassing)::numeric / COUNT(t2.team_long_name)
    FROM public.team_attributes AS ta2
    JOIN public.team AS t2
      ON t2.team_api_id = ta2.team_api_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ta2.date::date) = 2012
      AND ta2.buildupplaypassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday::date) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992
  ) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.player_fifa_api_id), 0) AS percentage
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id;

SELECT AVG(pa.long_shots) AS average_long_shots
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(pa.heading_accuracy)::numeric / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT l.name
FROM public.league AS l
JOIN public.match AS m
  ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
HAVING SUM(m.home_team_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id)
     > SUM(m.away_team_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id);

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pa.date::date) = 2011;

SELECT AVG(m.home_team_goal) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM public.match AS m
JOIN public.league AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE l.name = 'Poland'
  AND m.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT
  p.player_name,
  p.height,
  AVG(pa.finishing) AS average_finishing
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height IN (
  (SELECT MAX(height) FROM public.player),
  (SELECT MIN(height) FROM public.player)
)
GROUP BY p.id, p.player_name, p.height
ORDER BY average_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(pa.overall_rating)::numeric / COUNT(pa.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pa.date::date) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2015
  AND p.height > 170;

SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control END)
  - AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control END) AS difference_of_average_ball_control
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye');

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN a.birthday < b.birthday THEN 'Aaron Lennon'
    WHEN b.birthday < a.birthday THEN 'Abdelaziz Barrada'
    ELSE 'Same age'
  END AS older_player
FROM public.player AS a
JOIN public.player AS b
  ON a.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'
 AND b.player_name = 'Abdelaziz Barrada';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM public.player_attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate = 'low';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday::date) < 1986
  AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.volleys > 70
  AND pa.dribbling > 70
  AND p.player_name IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM public.match AS m
JOIN public.league AS l
  ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT l.name
FROM public.league AS l
JOIN public.match AS m ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  ((
    AVG(pa_a.overall_rating) - AVG(pa_p.overall_rating)
  ) / NULLIF(AVG(pa_p.overall_rating), 0)) * 100 AS percentage_higher
FROM player AS a
JOIN player_attributes AS pa_a
  ON pa_a.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
JOIN player AS p
  ON p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
JOIN player_attributes AS pa_p
  ON pa_p.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE a.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating)
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Pietro Marino';

SELECT MAX(ta.chancecreationpassing) AS highest_chance_creation_passing_score,
       ta.chancecreationpassingclass AS classification
FROM public.team AS t
JOIN public.team_attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Ajax'
GROUP BY ta.chancecreationpassingclass
ORDER BY highest_chance_creation_passing_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77
  AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT pa.date
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
    FROM public.player_attributes AS pa2
    JOIN public.player AS p2
      ON p2.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id
    WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY pa.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ta.buildupplaypassingclass
FROM public.team AS t
JOIN public.team_attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient'
  AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT ta.defenceaggressionclass
FROM public.team AS t
JOIN public.team_attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND ta.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND LEFT(pa.date, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT (100.0 * (ld.overall_rating - jb.overall_rating) / ld.overall_rating) AS percentage
FROM player_attributes AS ld
JOIN player AS ldp ON ldp.player_api_id = ld.player_api_id
JOIN player_attributes AS jb
  ON jb.date = ld.date
JOIN player AS jbp ON jbp.player_api_id = jb.player_api_id
WHERE ldp.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
  AND jbp.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
  AND ld.date = '2013/7/12'
  AND jb.date = '2013/7/12';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE LOWER(pa.attacking_work_rate) = 'high'
  AND p.player_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.player_name;

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name
FROM public.team AS t
JOIN public.team_attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.chancecreationpassingclass = 'Safe';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM public.player
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT id
FROM player_attributes
WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM player_attributes)
  AND LOWER(preferred_foot) = 'right'
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 4;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id)
FROM public.player_attributes AS pa
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(crossing)
    FROM public.player_attributes
  );

SELECT
  m.home_team_goal,
  m.away_team_goal
FROM public.match AS m
JOIN public.league AS l
  ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%';

SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildupplayspeedclass
FROM public.team AS t
JOIN public.team_attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT p.player_name, pa.finishing AS finishing_rate, pa.curve AS curve_score
FROM public.player AS p
JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM public.player);

SELECT l.name, COUNT(m.id) AS game_count
FROM public.league AS l
JOIN public.match AS m
  ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY game_count DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM public.match AS m
JOIN public.team AS t
  ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
WHERE m.away_team_goal = (
  SELECT MAX(away_team_goal)
  FROM public.match
);

SELECT player_name
FROM player
JOIN player_attributes ON player.player_api_id = player_attributes.player_api_id
WHERE player_attributes.overall_rating = (
  SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
  FROM player_attributes
);

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.height < 180 AND pa.overall_rating > 70) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 0) AS percentage
FROM public.player AS p
LEFT JOIN public.player_attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id;

SELECT d.driverref
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
WHERE q.raceid = 20
  AND q.q1 = (
    SELECT MAX(q1)
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceid = 20
  );

SELECT d.surname
FROM public.qualifying q
JOIN public.drivers d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
WHERE q.raceid = 19
  AND q.q2 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2)
    FROM public.qualifying
    WHERE raceid = 19
      AND q2 IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT name
FROM public.races
WHERE circuitid IN (
  SELECT circuitid
  FROM public.circuits
  WHERE country = 'Germany'
);

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM public.races AS r
JOIN public.circuits AS c
  ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid
WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM public.races AS r
JOIN public.circuits AS c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid
WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix';

SELECT q.q1
FROM public.qualifying AS q
JOIN public.drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
WHERE q.raceid = 354
  AND d.forename = 'Bruno'
  AND d.surname = 'Senna';

SELECT d.number
FROM public.qualifying AS q
JOIN public.drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
WHERE q.raceid = 903
  AND q.q3 LIKE '1:54%';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS drivers_not_finished
FROM public.results AS r
JOIN public.races AS ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE ra.year = 2007
  AND ra.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix'
  AND r.time IS NULL;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
WHERE r.raceid = 592
  AND r.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.dob ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS player, d.url
FROM public.laptimes AS lt
JOIN public.drivers AS d ON d.driverid = lt.driverid
WHERE lt.raceid = 161
  AND lt.time LIKE '1:27%';

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM public.races AS r
JOIN public.circuits AS c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid
WHERE r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix';

SELECT c.url
FROM public.constructorresults AS cr
JOIN public.constructors AS c
  ON c.constructorid = cr.constructorid
WHERE cr.raceid = 9
  AND cr.points = (
    SELECT MAX(points)
    FROM public.constructorresults
    WHERE raceid = 9
  );

SELECT d.code
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
WHERE q.raceid = 45
  AND q.q3 LIKE '0:01:33%';

SELECT s.url
FROM public.races AS r
JOIN public.seasons AS s
  ON s.year = r.year
WHERE r.raceid = 901;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE r.raceid = 872
  AND r.time IS NOT NULL
  AND d.dob = (
    SELECT MAX(d2.dob)
    FROM drivers AS d2
    JOIN results AS r2 ON r2.driverid = d2.driverid
    WHERE r2.raceid = 872
      AND r2.time IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT d.nationality
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
WHERE r.fastestlapspeed::double precision = (
  SELECT MAX(fastestlapspeed::double precision)
  FROM results
  WHERE fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT
  ((r853.fastestlapspeed_num - r854.fastestlapspeed_num) * 100.0
   / NULLIF(r853.fastestlapspeed_num, 0)) AS percent_faster
FROM (
  SELECT res.fastestlapspeed::double precision AS fastestlapspeed_num
  FROM results res
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = res.driverid
  WHERE res.raceid = 853
    AND d.forename = 'Paul'
    AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
) r853
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT res.fastestlapspeed::double precision AS fastestlapspeed_num
  FROM results res
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = res.driverid
  WHERE res.raceid = 854
    AND d.forename = 'Paul'
    AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
) r854;

SELECT
  d.driverid,
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS race_completion_rate
FROM races ra
JOIN results r ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
WHERE ra.date = DATE '1983-07-16'
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname;

SELECT name
FROM public.races
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (SELECT MIN(date) FROM public.races))
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (SELECT MIN(date) FROM public.races));

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
       SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
FROM public.drivers AS d
JOIN public.driverstandings AS ds
  ON ds.driverid = d.driverid
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver,
  r.name AS race,
  lt.time AS lap_time,
  lt.milliseconds
FROM public.laptimes AS lt
JOIN public.drivers AS d
  ON d.driverid = lt.driverid
JOIN public.races AS r
  ON r.raceid = lt.raceid
WHERE lt.milliseconds = (
  SELECT MIN(milliseconds)
  FROM public.laptimes
);

SELECT AVG(l.milliseconds) AS average_lap_time_milliseconds
FROM public.laptimes AS l
JOIN public.drivers AS d ON d.driverid = l.driverid
JOIN public.races AS r ON r.raceid = l.raceid
WHERE d.forename || ' ' || d.surname = 'Lewis Hamilton'
  AND r.year = 2009
  AND r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix';

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE res.position > 1)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage
FROM public.results AS res
JOIN public.drivers AS d ON d.driverid = res.driverid
JOIN public.races AS r ON r.raceid = res.raceid
WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.year >= 2010;

SELECT
  d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
  d.nationality,
  MAX(ds.points) AS maximum_point_score
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN driverstandings AS ds
  ON ds.driverid = d.driverid
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
HAVING SUM(ds.wins) = (
  SELECT MAX(total_wins)
  FROM (
    SELECT driverid, SUM(wins) AS total_wins
    FROM driverstandings
    GROUP BY driverid
  ) AS winning_totals
);

SELECT
  CONCAT(forename, ' ', surname) AS name,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dob)::int AS age
FROM public.drivers
WHERE nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND dob IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY dob DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, c.location
FROM public.races AS r
JOIN public.circuits AS c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid
WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.date) = 9
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2005;

SELECT DISTINCT r.name AS race
FROM public.results AS res
JOIN public.drivers AS d ON d.driverid = res.driverid
JOIN public.races AS r ON r.raceid = res.raceid
WHERE d.forename = 'Alex'
  AND d.surname = 'Yoong'
  AND res.position < 20;

SELECT r.name AS race, r.year
FROM results res
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = res.driverid
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = res.raceid
WHERE d.forename = 'Michael'
  AND d.surname = 'Schumacher'
  AND res.milliseconds = (
    SELECT MIN(res2.milliseconds)
    FROM results res2
    JOIN drivers d2 ON d2.driverid = res2.driverid
    WHERE d2.forename = 'Michael'
      AND d2.surname = 'Schumacher'
      AND res2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT r.name AS first_race, r.year, res.points
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON res.driverid = d.driverid
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = res.raceid
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.year = (
    SELECT MIN(r2.year)
    FROM results res2
    JOIN races r2 ON r2.raceid = res2.raceid
    JOIN drivers d2 ON d2.driverid = res2.driverid
    WHERE d2.forename = 'Lewis'
      AND d2.surname = 'Hamilton'
  );

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.country = 'Germany')
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage
FROM public.races AS r
JOIN public.circuits AS c
  ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid
WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix';

SELECT d.driverref
FROM public.results r
JOIN public.drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
JOIN public.races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2007
  AND r.position = 1;

SELECT r.name AS race, r.year, r.date, res.rank
FROM results AS res
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = res.driverid
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = res.raceid
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND res.rank = (
    SELECT MIN(res2.rank)
    FROM results AS res2
    JOIN drivers AS d2 ON d2.driverid = res2.driverid
    WHERE d2.forename = 'Lewis'
      AND d2.surname = 'Hamilton'
      AND res2.rank IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT MAX(CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS numeric)) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM public.results AS r
JOIN public.races AS ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND ra.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix';

SELECT r.positionorder AS final_rank
FROM results AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year = 2008
  AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix';

SELECT r.time
FROM public.results r
JOIN public.races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE ra.year = 2008
  AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND r.position = 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS driver_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.driverid
    FROM public.results r
    JOIN public.races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
    JOIN public.laptimes l
      ON l.raceid = r.raceid
     AND l.driverid = r.driverid
    WHERE ra.year = 2008
      AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
      AND r.time IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.results r2
          WHERE r2.driverid = r.driverid
            AND r2.raceid IS NOT NULL
      )
) AS finished_drivers;

SELECT
  ((last_driver_time_ms - champion_time_ms)::numeric / last_driver_time_ms) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.position = 1 THEN r.milliseconds END) AS champion_time_ms,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.position = max_position THEN r.milliseconds END) AS last_driver_time_ms
  FROM (
    SELECT
      res.*,
      MAX(res.position) OVER () AS max_position
    FROM public.results res
    JOIN public.races ra ON ra.raceid = res.raceid
    WHERE ra.year = 2008
      AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
  ) r
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS circuit_count
FROM public.circuits
WHERE location = 'Adelaide'
  AND country = 'Australia';

SELECT MAX(cr.points) AS maximum_points
FROM public.constructorresults AS cr
JOIN public.constructors AS c
  ON c.constructorid = cr.constructorid
WHERE c.nationality = 'British';

SELECT c.name
FROM public.constructors AS c
JOIN public.constructorresults AS cr
  ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid
WHERE cr.raceid = 291
  AND cr.points = 0;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c.constructorid
    FROM public.constructors AS c
    JOIN public.constructorresults AS cr
      ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Japanese'
      AND cr.points = 0
    GROUP BY c.constructorid
    HAVING COUNT(cr.raceid) = 2
) AS qualifying_constructors;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS race_completion_percentage
FROM results AS r
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

SELECT
  r.year,
  AVG(
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      split_part(res.time, ':', 1)::numeric * INTERVAL '1 hour' +
      split_part(res.time, ':', 2)::numeric * INTERVAL '1 minute' +
      split_part(split_part(res.time, ':', 3), '.', 1)::numeric * INTERVAL '1 second' +
      COALESCE(
        ('0.' || split_part(split_part(res.time, ':', 3), '.', 2))::numeric * INTERVAL '1 second',
        INTERVAL '0'
      )
    ))
  ) AS average_champion_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res
  ON res.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN driverstandings ds
  ON ds.raceid = r.raceid
 AND ds.driverid = res.driverid
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND ds.position = 1
  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT r.fastestlap
FROM results AS r
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN driverstandings AS ds ON ds.raceid = r.raceid
  AND ds.driverid = r.driverid
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND ds.position = 1
ORDER BY r.fastestlap ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS double precision)) AS average_fastest_lap_speed
FROM public.results AS r
JOIN public.races AS ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND ra.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
  AND r.fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) < 1985 AND r.laps > 50 THEN r.driverid END)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverid), 0) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid)
FROM public.drivers AS d
JOIN public.laptimes AS l
  ON l.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE d.nationality = 'French'
  AND l.milliseconds < 120000;

SELECT
  STRING_AGG(d.code, ', ' ORDER BY d.dob DESC) AS top_3_youngest_driver_codes,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.nationality = 'Dutch') AS netherlandic_driver_count
FROM (
  SELECT code, nationality, dob
  FROM public.drivers
  WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY dob DESC
  LIMIT 3
) AS d;

SELECT driverref
FROM public.drivers
WHERE nationality = 'German'
  AND dob = (
    SELECT MIN(dob)
    FROM public.drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'German'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.driverid AS id, d.code
FROM public.drivers AS d
JOIN public.results AS r
  ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) = 1971
  AND r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS disqualified_finishers
FROM public.results
WHERE raceid > 50
  AND raceid < 100
  AND statusid = 2
  AND time IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS circuit_count,
  location,
  lat,
  lng
FROM public.circuits
WHERE country = 'Austria';

SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date)::bigint AS year,
  CONCAT(d.forename, ' ', d.surname) AS driver_name,
  r.name AS race_name,
  r.date AS race_date,
  r.time AS race_time
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN qualifying AS q
  ON q.driverid = d.driverid
JOIN races AS r
  ON r.raceid = q.raceid
WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL)
  AND r.date = (
    SELECT MIN(r2.date)
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    JOIN races AS r2
      ON r2.raceid = q2.raceid
    WHERE q2.driverid = d.driverid
  );

SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
    AVG(p.milliseconds) AS average_pit_stop_duration_milliseconds
FROM public.drivers AS d
JOIN public.pitstops AS p
    ON p.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= DATE '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob < DATE '1986-01-01'
  AND p.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY average_pit_stop_duration_milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS champion, r.time AS finish_time
FROM public.results r
JOIN public.races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN public.drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
WHERE ra.year = 2008
  AND ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.position = 1;

SELECT c.constructorref, c.url
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid
WHERE r.year = 2009
  AND r.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix'
ORDER BY res.positionorder ASC, res.position ASC, res.milliseconds DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN public.superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man';

SELECT c.points, co.name, co.nationality
FROM (
  SELECT r.constructorid, SUM(r.points) AS points
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
  WHERE ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
    AND ra.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
  GROUP BY r.constructorid
  ORDER BY points DESC
  LIMIT 1
) c
JOIN constructors co ON co.constructorid = c.constructorid;

SELECT CONCAT(d.forename, ' ', d.surname) AS full_name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = q.raceid
JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND r.round = 3
  AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
    FROM qualifying q2
    WHERE q2.raceid = q.raceid
      AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT
  d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
  d.nationality,
  r.name AS first_race
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON res.driverid = d.driverid
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = res.raceid
WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
  AND r.date = (
    SELECT MIN(r2.date)
    FROM results res2
    JOIN races r2 ON r2.raceid = res2.raceid
    WHERE res2.driverid = d.driverid
  );

SELECT MAX(accident_count) AS highest_number_of_accidents
FROM (
  SELECT r.driverid, COUNT(*) AS accident_count
  FROM public.results AS r
  JOIN public.races AS ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
  WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
    AND r.statusid = 3
  GROUP BY r.driverid
) AS accident_counts;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM laptimes AS l
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = l.driverid
WHERE l.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  split_part(l.time, ':', 1)::numeric * 60
  + split_part(split_part(l.time, ':', 2), '.', 1)::numeric
  + ('0.' || split_part(split_part(l.time, ':', 2), '.', 2))::numeric
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  c.name AS circuit_name,
  c.location,
  c.country,
  MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS lap_record_milliseconds,
  MIN(lt.time) FILTER (
    WHERE lt.milliseconds = (
      SELECT MIN(lt2.milliseconds)
      FROM public.laptimes AS lt2
      JOIN public.races AS r2 ON r2.raceid = lt2.raceid
      WHERE r2.circuitid = c.circuitid
    )
  ) AS lap_record_time
FROM public.circuits AS c
JOIN public.races AS r ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid
JOIN public.laptimes AS lt ON lt.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.location, c.country
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN public.superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
  AND s.height_cm > 200;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.colour AS c
  ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
JOIN public.hero_power AS hp
  ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN public.superpower AS sp
  ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Agility';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.colour AS eye_colour
  ON eye_colour.id = s.eye_colour_id
JOIN public.colour AS hair_colour
  ON hair_colour.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE eye_colour.colour = 'Blue'
  AND hair_colour.colour = 'Blond';

SELECT
  s.superhero_name,
  s.height_cm,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.publisher AS p
  ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY height_rank, s.superhero_name;

SELECT
  c.colour AS eye_color,
  COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.publisher AS p
  ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN public.colour AS c
  ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY superhero_count DESC;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.publisher AS p
  ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN public.hero_power AS hp
  ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN public.superpower AS sp
  ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN public.hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN public.attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM public.hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN public.attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.colour AS c
  ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
JOIN public.publisher AS p
  ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE c.colour = 'Gold'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN public.attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM public.hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN public.attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  );

SELECT r.race
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Copycat';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.hero_attribute AS ha
  ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN public.attribute AS a
  ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Durability'
  AND ha.attribute_value < 50;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN public.superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Death Touch';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN public.hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN public.attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad') * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage_bad_superheroes,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
      AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  ) AS bad_superheroes_published_by_marvel_comics
FROM public.superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN public.alignment AS a
  ON a.id = s.alignment_id
LEFT JOIN public.publisher AS p
  ON p.id = s.publisher_id;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')
  - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS difference
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM public.superhero AS sh
JOIN public.gender AS g ON g.id = sh.gender_id
JOIN public.hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
JOIN public.superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND sp.power_name IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.colour AS c
  ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT c.colour
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
JOIN public.colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / COUNT(*) AS marvel_percentage
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.publisher AS p
  ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM public.superhero AS s
JOIN public.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND s.weight_kg > 0.79 * (SELECT AVG(weight_kg) FROM public.superhero);

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM public.hero_power hp
JOIN public.superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.hero_id) AS hero_count
FROM public.hero_power AS hp
JOIN public.superpower AS sp
  ON sp.id = hp.power_id

 AND ph.userid = c.userid

JOIN public.sets AS s

WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM public.cards AS c
JOIN public.sets AS s
  ON s.code = c.setcode
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.convertedmanacost > 5
  AND (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL);

SELECT flavortext
FROM public.foreign_data
WHERE language = 'Italian'
  AND name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen';

SELECT DISTINCT r.text
FROM public.cards AS c
JOIN public.sets AS s
  ON s.code = c.setcode
JOIN public.rulings AS r
  ON r.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN public.foreign_data AS f
  ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND f.language = 'Italian';

SELECT fd.name
FROM public.cards AS c
JOIN public.sets AS s
  ON s.code = c.setcode
JOIN public.foreign_data AS fd
  ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'
  AND c.convertedmanacost = (
    SELECT MAX(c2.convertedmanacost)
    FROM public.cards AS c2
    JOIN public.sets AS s2
      ON s2.code = c2.setcode
    WHERE s2.name = 'Coldsnap'
  );

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.convertedmanacost = 7) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage
FROM public.cards AS c
JOIN public.sets AS s
  ON s.code = c.setcode
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE c.cardkingdomfoilid IS NOT NULL
      AND c.cardkingdomid IS NOT NULL
  ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage
FROM public.cards AS c
JOIN public.sets AS s
  ON s.code = c.setcode
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT
  l.format,
  c.name
FROM public.legalities AS l
JOIN public.cards AS c
  ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format IN (
    SELECT format
    FROM public.legalities
    WHERE status = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY format
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
      SELECT MAX(banned_count)
      FROM (
        SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_count
        FROM public.legalities
        WHERE status = 'Banned'
        GROUP BY format
      ) AS counts
    )
  )
ORDER BY l.format, c.name;

SELECT c.name, l.format
FROM public.cards AS c
JOIN public.legalities AS l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.edhrecrank = 1
  AND l.status = 'Banned';

SELECT c.name, l.format
FROM public.cards AS c
JOIN public.sets AS s
  ON s.code = c.setcode
JOIN public.legalities AS l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
ORDER BY c.name, l.format;

SELECT s.name
FROM public.sets AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.set_translations AS st
    WHERE st.setcode = s.code
      AND st.language = 'Korean'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.set_translations AS st
    WHERE st.setcode = s.code
      AND st.language LIKE '%Japanese%'
);

SELECT DISTINCT
  c.frameversion AS frame_style,
  c.name AS card_name,
  CASE WHEN l.status = 'Banned' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_banned
FROM public.cards AS c
LEFT JOIN public.legalities AS l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams'
ORDER BY c.frameversion, c.name;

SELECT bond_type
FROM public.bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count)
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'o') AS oxygen_count
  FROM public.molecule AS m
  JOIN public.bond AS b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN public.atom AS a
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS molecule_oxygen_counts;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(c.atom_id), 0) AS average_single_bonds_per_atom
FROM public.molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN public.bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN public.connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM public.molecule AS m
JOIN public.bond AS b
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'c') / NULLIF(COUNT(a.atom_id), 0) AS percentage
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM public.bond
  WHERE bond_type = '='
) AS d ON d.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM public.connected AS c
JOIN public.atom AS a
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN public.bond AS b
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
  AND a.element IS NOT NULL;

SELECT m.label
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
GROUP BY m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.element
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM public.connected AS c
JOIN public.bond AS b
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.bond AS b
  ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element IN ('i', 's')
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element <> 'f' OR a.element IS NULL THEN m.molecule_id END)
       / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id), 0)
FROM public.molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN public.atom AS a
  ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN m.molecule_id END)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END), 0) AS percent
FROM molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN bond AS b
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT element
FROM public.atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
  AND element IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type = '=')
  / NULLIF(COUNT(bond_id), 0),
  5
) AS percentage
FROM public.bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(molecule_id), 0), 3) AS percentage
FROM public.molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element, m.label
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR060';

SELECT b.bond_type,
       COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
       CASE
           WHEN COUNT(*) = (
               SELECT MAX(bond_count)
               FROM (
                   SELECT COUNT(*) AS bond_count
                   FROM public.bond
                   WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
                   GROUP BY bond_type
               ) AS counts
           ) THEN 'majority bond type'
           ELSE 'not majority bond type'
       END AS majority_status,
       m.label AS carcinogenicity
FROM public.bond AS b
JOIN public.molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM public.molecule AS m
JOIN public.bond AS b
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN public.connected AS c
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)
FROM public.bond AS b
JOIN public.connected AS c
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR009'
  AND (c.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12');

SELECT
  b.bond_type,
  c.atom_id,
  c.atom_id2
FROM public.bond AS b
JOIN public.connected AS c
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM public.connected AS c
WHERE c.atom_id = '19'
   OR c.atom_id2 = '19';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM public.molecule AS m
JOIN public.atom AS a
  ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT b.*
FROM public.bond AS b
JOIN public.connected AS c
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN public.atom AS a1
  ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN public.atom AS a2
  ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')
   OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN (
        SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
        GROUP BY molecule_id
    ) AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE b.double_bond_count = (
        SELECT MAX(double_bond_count)
        FROM (
            SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
            FROM bond
            WHERE bond_type = ' = '
            GROUP BY molecule_id
        ) AS counts
    )
    AND m.label = '+'
) AS most_double_bonds_is_carcinogenic;

SELECT AVG(bond_count)
FROM (
  SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM public.atom AS a
  LEFT JOIN public.connected AS c
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE a.element = 'i'
  GROUP BY a.atom_id
) AS atom_bond_counts;

SELECT element
FROM public.atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (
    SELECT atom_id FROM public.connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM public.connected
);

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM public.connected AS c
JOIN public.bond AS b
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN public.atom AS a
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.connected AS c
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN public.bond AS b
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.label = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(b.bond_id), 0), 5) AS percentage
FROM public.bond AS b
JOIN public.molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM public.bond AS b
  WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    AND b.bond_type = '#'
)
AND a.element IN ('p', 'br');

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percent
FROM atom AS a
JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id), 0) AS percentage
FROM public.molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN public.atom AS a
  ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS toxicology_element_count
FROM public.atom AS a
JOIN public.molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTRING(a.atom_id FROM 7 FOR 1) = '4'
  AND a.element = 'N';

SELECT
  m.label,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(a.element), 0) AS hydrogen_ratio
FROM public.molecule AS m
JOIN public.atom AS a
  ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM public.molecule AS m
JOIN public.atom AS a
  ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM public.satscores ss
JOIN public.schools s
  ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.avgscrmath > 400
  AND s.virtual = 'F';

SELECT MAX(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM public.satscores AS s
JOIN public.frpm AS f
  ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE s.numtsttakr > 0
  AND s.numge1500::numeric / s.numtsttakr > 0.3;

SELECT
  s.sname AS school_name,
  s.avgscrwrite AS average_writing_score,
  sch.charternum AS charter_number,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.avgscrwrite DESC) AS rank
FROM public.satscores AS s
JOIN public.schools AS sch
  ON s.cds = sch.cdscode
WHERE s.avgscrwrite > 499
  AND sch.charternum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rank, school_name;

SELECT
  f."School Name" AS school_name,
  s.street AS street_address
FROM public.frpm AS f
JOIN public.schools AS s
  ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30;

SELECT DISTINCT f."School Name"
FROM public.frpm AS f
JOIN public.satscores AS s
  ON f.cdscode = s.cds
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" <> 0
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND s.numge1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND s.numge1500 > 0;

SELECT
  s.sname AS school_name,
  sc.fundingtype AS funding_type
FROM public.satscores AS s
JOIN public.schools AS sc
  ON sc.cdscode = s.cds
WHERE s.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.sname, sc.fundingtype
HAVING AVG(s.avgscrmath) > 400;

SELECT
  s.school AS school_name,
  s.street,
  s.city,
  s.state,
  s.zip
FROM public.schools AS s
JOIN public.frpm AS f
  ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE LOWER(f."County Name") = 'monterey'
  AND LOWER(f."High Grade") IN ('9', '10', '11', '12')
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT
  s.school AS school_name,
  ss.avgscrwrite AS average_writing_score,
  s.phone AS communication_number
FROM public.schools AS s
JOIN public.satscores AS ss
  ON ss.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.opendate > DATE '1991-12-31'
   OR s.closeddate < DATE '2000-01-01';

SELECT
  s.school,
  s.doctype
FROM public.frpm AS f
JOIN public.schools AS s
  ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally Funded'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > (
    SELECT AVG("Enrollment (K-12)" - "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM public.frpm
    WHERE "Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally Funded'
  );

SELECT
  "School Name",
  "Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS eligible_free_rate
FROM public.frpm
WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
OFFSET 9
LIMIT 2;

SELECT
  f."School Name",
  f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM public.frpm AS f
JOIN public.schools AS s
  ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.soc = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  s.street AS "Street",
  s.city AS "City",
  s.zip AS "Zip",
  s.state AS "State"
FROM public.satsscores AS ss
JOIN public.schools AS s
  ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.numtsttakr > 0
ORDER BY ss.numge1500::numeric / ss.numtsttakr ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CONCAT_WS(', ', NULLIF(s.admfname1, '') || ' ' || NULLIF(s.admlname1, ''), NULLIF(s.admfname2, '') || ' ' || NULLIF(s.admlname2, ''), NULLIF(s.admfname3, '') || ' ' || NULLIF(s.admlname3, '')) AS administrator_full_names
FROM public.satscores AS ss
JOIN public.schools AS s
  ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.numge1500 = (
  SELECT MAX(numge1500)
  FROM public.satscores
);

SELECT AVG(s.numtsttakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM public.satscores AS s
JOIN public.schools AS sch
  ON s.cds = sch.cdscode
WHERE sch.county = 'Fresno'
  AND sch.opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01'
  AND sch.opendate <= DATE '1980-12-31';

SELECT s.phone
FROM public.satscores AS ss
JOIN public.schools AS s
  ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND ss.avgscrread IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss.avgscrread ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT school_name
FROM (
    SELECT
        s.school AS school_name,
        s.county,
        ss.avgscrread,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.county
            ORDER BY ss.avgscrread DESC
        ) AS county_rank
    FROM public.schools AS s
    JOIN public.satscores AS ss
        ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
    WHERE s.virtual = 'F'
      AND ss.avgscrread IS NOT NULL
) ranked
WHERE county_rank <= 5;

SELECT
  s.school AS school,
  AVG(ss.avgscrwrite) AS average_writing_score
FROM public.schools AS s
JOIN public.satscores AS ss
  ON ss.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE CONCAT_WS(' ', s.admfname1, s.admlname1) ILIKE '%Ricci Ulrich%'
   OR CONCAT_WS(' ', s.admfname2, s.admlname2) ILIKE '%Ricci Ulrich%'
   OR CONCAT_WS(' ', s.admfname3, s.admlname3) ILIKE '%Ricci Ulrich%'
GROUP BY s.school
ORDER BY s.school;

SELECT
  s."School Name",
  s."County Name",
  s."District Name",
  s."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollees
FROM public.frpm AS s
WHERE s."District Type" = 'State Special Schools'
ORDER BY s."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric / 12 AS monthly_average_schools_opened
FROM public.schools
WHERE county = 'Alameda'
  AND doc = '52'
  AND opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01'
  AND opendate < DATE '1981-01-01';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.doc = '54')::numeric
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.doc = '52'), 0) AS ratio
FROM public.schools AS s
WHERE s.county = 'Orange'
  AND s.statustype = 'Merged';

SELECT s.school AS school_name,
       s.street AS postal_street_address
FROM public.satscores AS ss
JOIN public.schools AS s
  ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss.avgscrmath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM public.frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
  AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18;

SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS enrolled_students
FROM public.frpm AS f
JOIN public.schools AS s
  ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND s.city = 'Fremont'
  AND s.edopscode = 'SSS';

SELECT
  "School Name",
  "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM public.frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND "High Grade" = '9';

SELECT
  county,
  COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM public.schools
WHERE virtual = 'F'
  AND county IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
GROUP BY county
ORDER BY school_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT gsserved
FROM public.schools
WHERE longitude = (
  SELECT MAX(ABS(longitude))
  FROM public.schools
  WHERE longitude IS NOT NULL
)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  s.city,
  COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM public.schools AS s
JOIN public.frpm AS f
  ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.magnet = 1
  AND f."Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND f."High Grade" = '8'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.city
ORDER BY s.city;

SELECT
  f."District Code",
  f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100 AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM public.frpm AS f
JOIN public.schools AS s
  ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE LOWER(s.admfname1) = 'alusine'
   OR LOWER(s.admfname2) = 'alusine'
   OR LOWER(s.admfname3) = 'alusine';

SELECT DISTINCT s.admemail1 AS administrator_email
FROM public.schools AS s
WHERE s.county = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.district = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND s.opendate BETWEEN DATE '2009-01-01' AND DATE '2010-12-31'
  AND s.soc = '62'
  AND s.doc = '54'
  AND s.admemail1 IS NOT NULL
  AND s.admemail1 ~* '^[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}$';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM public.account AS a
JOIN public.district AS d
  ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN public.trans AS t
  ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.a3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND t.k_symbol = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.district_id
    FROM public.client AS c
    JOIN public.account AS a
      ON a.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY c.district_id
    HAVING AVG(d.a11) > 6000
       AND AVG(d.a11) < 10000
) AS qualifying_districts
JOIN public.district AS d
  ON d.district_id = qualifying_districts.district_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM public.client AS c
JOIN public.district AS d
  ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.a3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND d.a11 > 8000;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    MIN(d.a11) AS lowest_average_salary,
    MAX(district_stats.max_average_salary) - MIN(d.a11) AS salary_gap
FROM public.account AS a
JOIN public.disp AS dp
    ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN public.client AS c
    ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN public.district AS d
    ON d.district_id = c.district_id
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(a11) AS max_average_salary
    FROM public.district
) AS district_stats
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (
      SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date)
      FROM public.client AS c2
      WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
  )
GROUP BY a.account_id, district_stats.max_average_salary
HAVING MIN(d.a11) = (
    SELECT MIN(d2.a11)
    FROM public.client AS c3
    JOIN public.district AS d2
      ON d2.district_id = c3.district_id
    WHERE c3.gender = 'F'
);

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM public.disp AS d
JOIN public.client AS c
  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN public.district AS di
  ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (
    SELECT MAX(c2.birth_date)
    FROM public.client AS c2
)
AND di.a11 = (
    SELECT MAX(di2.a11)
    FROM public.district AS di2
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM public.account AS a
JOIN public.loan AS l
  ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1997
  AND l.amount = (
    SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
    FROM public.loan AS l2
    WHERE l2.status = 'A'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l2.date) = 1997
  )
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM public.account AS a
JOIN public.loan AS l
  ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND l.status = 'A'
  AND a.date >= DATE '1993-01-01'
  AND a.date < DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND l.amount = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
    FROM public.loan AS l2
    JOIN public.account AS a2
      ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
    WHERE l2.duration > 12
      AND l2.status = 'A'
      AND a2.date >= DATE '1993-01-01'
      AND a2.date < DATE '1994-01-01'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM public.client AS c
JOIN public.district AS d
  ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN public.disp AS dp
  ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN public.account AS a
  ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01'
  AND d.a2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT d.a2
FROM public.client AS c
JOIN public.disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN public.account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN public.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = DATE '1976-01-29';

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS male_client_percentage
FROM public.client AS c
JOIN public.district AS d
  ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.a3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND d.a4 = (
    SELECT MAX(a4)
    FROM public.district
    WHERE a3 = 'south Bohemia'
  );

SELECT
  100.0 * (t_end.balance - t_start.balance) / NULLIF(t_start.balance, 0) AS increase_rate
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN trans AS t_start
  ON t_start.account_id = l.account_id
 AND t_start.date = DATE '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans AS t_end
  ON t_end.account_id = l.account_id
 AND t_end.date = DATE '1998-12-27'
WHERE l.status = 'A'
  AND l.date = DATE '1993-07-05'
  AND l.loan_id = (
    SELECT loan_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'A'
    ORDER BY date, loan_id
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY d.client_id, d.disp_id, t_start.trans_id, t_end.trans_id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
  / NULLIF(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS percentage_running_no_issue
FROM public.loan AS l
WHERE l.amount < 100000;

SELECT
    d.district_id,
    d.a2 AS district,
    CASE
        WHEN d.a12 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100
    END AS unemployment_rate_increment_percentage
FROM public.loan AS l
JOIN public.account AS a
    ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN public.district AS d
    ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2, d.a12, d.a13
ORDER BY d.district_id;

SELECT
    d.district_id,
    d.a2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM public.district AS d
JOIN public.client AS c
    ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN public.disp AS dp
    ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN public.account AS a
    ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_loan_count
FROM public.loan AS l
JOIN public.account AS a
  ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN public.disp AS d
  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM public.account AS a
JOIN public.loan AS l
  ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN public.district AS d
  ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_client_count
FROM public.client c
JOIN public.district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.a15 = (
    SELECT a15
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT a15
      FROM public.district
      WHERE a15 IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY a15 DESC
      OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1
    ) AS second_highest
  );

SELECT
  d.a2 AS district_name,
  SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM public.trans AS t
JOIN public.account AS a
  ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN public.district AS d
  ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date >= DATE '1996-01-01'
  AND t.date < DATE '1996-02-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.card AS c
    JOIN public.disp AS dp
      ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE dp.account_id = t.account_id
  )
GROUP BY d.a2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM public.loan AS l
JOIN public.account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_client_count
FROM public.client c
JOIN public.district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.a15 = (
    SELECT MAX(a15)
    FROM public.district
    WHERE a15 < (SELECT MAX(a15) FROM public.district)
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM public.disp AS d
JOIN public.trans AS t
  ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.amount < (
    SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
    FROM public.trans AS t2
    WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t2.date) = 1998
  )
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date) = 1998;

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.a11 AS average_income,
    disp.type AS account_type
FROM public.account AS a
JOIN public.disp AS disp
    ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN public.district AS d
    ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE disp.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND d.a11 > 8000
  AND d.a11 <= 9000;

SELECT AVG(d.a15) AS average_crimes
FROM public.district AS d
WHERE d.a15 > 4000
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.account AS a
    WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
      AND a.date >= DATE '1997-01-01'
  );

SELECT t.*
FROM public.trans AS t
JOIN public.disp AS d
  ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage_women
FROM public.client AS c
JOIN public.disp AS d
  ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN public.account AS a
  ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN public.district AS dist
  ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dist.a11 > 10000;

SELECT
  (
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
  )::numeric
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
  * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM public.loan AS l
JOIN public.account AS a
  ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN public.disp AS d
  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN public.client AS c
  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) IN (1996, 1997);

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE t.operation ILIKE '%statement%'
       OR t.type ILIKE '%statement%'
  ) AS statement_request_count,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.k_symbol, ', ' ORDER BY t.k_symbol)
    FILTER (WHERE t.amount = 3539 AND t.type ILIKE '%debit%') AS debit_3539_purposes
FROM public.trans AS t
WHERE t.account_id = 3;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 0) AS percentage_male_clients
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM public.disp AS d
JOIN public.client AS c
  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN public.district AS dist
  ON dist.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (
    SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date)
    FROM public.client AS c2
    WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
  )
  AND dist.a11 = (
    SELECT MIN(dist2.a11)
    FROM public.client AS c3
    JOIN public.district AS dist2
      ON dist2.district_id = c3.district_id
    WHERE c3.gender = 'F'
  );

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM public.loan AS l
JOIN public.account AS a
  ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN public.trans AS t
  ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND t.k_symbol = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.client_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, c.birth_date))::int AS age
FROM public.client AS c
JOIN public.disp AS d
    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN public.card AS ca
    ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT a.aid, a.name
FROM public.author AS a
JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid
JOIN public.domain_publication AS dp_ml ON dp_ml.pid = w.pid
JOIN public.domain AS d_ml ON d_ml.did = dp_ml.did AND d_ml.name = 'Machine Learning'
JOIN public.domain_publication AS dp_ds ON dp_ds.pid = w.pid
JOIN public.domain AS d_ds ON d_ds.did = dp_ds.did AND d_ds.name = 'Data Science';

SELECT a.aid, a.name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.cited = w.pid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_citations FROM public.author AS a LEFT JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid LEFT JOIN public.cite AS c ON c.cited = w.pid GROUP BY a.aid, a.name ORDER BY a.aid

SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS publication_count
FROM public.publication
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT d.name AS domain_name, AVG(p.reference_num) AS average_references_cited
FROM public.domain AS d
JOIN public.domain_publication AS dp ON dp.did = d.did
JOIN public.publication AS p ON p.pid = dp.pid
GROUP BY d.did, d.name
ORDER BY d.name;
SELECT year, AVG(citation_num) AS average_citations_received FROM public.publication WHERE year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;
SELECT title FROM public.publication WHERE citation_num = (SELECT MAX(citation_num) FROM public.publication);

SELECT d.did, d.name, COUNT(DISTINCT da.aid) AS author_count
FROM public.domain AS d
JOIN public.domain_author AS da ON da.did = d.did
GROUP BY d.did, d.name
ORDER BY author_count DESC, d.did
LIMIT 5;
SELECT title, reference_num FROM public.publication ORDER BY reference_num DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3;
SELECT pid, title, citation_num FROM public.publication ORDER BY citation_num DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3;
SELECT title FROM public.publication ORDER BY title ASC;
SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.author), 0) AS publication_to_author_ratio FROM public.publication;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cid IS NOT NULL)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE jid IS NOT NULL), 0) AS conference_to_journal_ratio FROM public.publication;

SELECT d.did AS domain_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.pid)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dk.kid), 0) AS publication_to_keyword_ratio FROM public.domain AS d LEFT JOIN public.domain_publication AS dp ON dp.did = d.did LEFT JOIN public.domain_keyword AS dk ON dk.did = d.did GROUP BY d.did ORDER BY d.did;

SELECT p.year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.pid) AS publication_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.jid) AS journal_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.pid)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.jid), 0) AS publications_per_journal FROM public.publication AS p WHERE p.year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.year ORDER BY p.year

SELECT o.continent, COUNT(DISTINCT a.aid)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.oid), 0) AS author_to_organization_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT a.aid) AS author_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.oid) AS organization_count FROM public.organization AS o LEFT JOIN public.author AS a ON a.oid = o.oid GROUP BY o.continent ORDER BY o.continent;

SELECT a.aid, a.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.pid) AS publication_count FROM public.author AS a JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid JOIN public.publication AS p ON p.pid = w.pid WHERE p.year = 2021 GROUP BY a.aid, a.name ORDER BY publication_count DESC, a.aid LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.cid, c.name, COUNT(p.pid) AS publication_count
FROM public.conference AS c
LEFT JOIN public.publication AS p ON p.cid = c.cid
GROUP BY c.cid, c.name
ORDER BY c.cid

SELECT j.jid, j.name AS journal_name, COUNT(p.pid) AS publication_count
FROM public.journal AS j
LEFT JOIN public.publication AS p ON p.jid = j.jid
GROUP BY j.jid, j.name
ORDER BY publication_count DESC, j.jid;

SELECT c.name AS conference_name, COUNT(p.pid) AS publication_count
FROM public.conference AS c
LEFT JOIN public.publication AS p ON p.cid = c.cid
GROUP BY c.cid, c.name
ORDER BY publication_count DESC, conference_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS publication_count
FROM public.publication AS p
JOIN public.journal AS j ON j.jid = p.jid
WHERE j.name LIKE 'J%';

SELECT DISTINCT o.oid, o.name, o.homepage, o.continent
FROM public.organization AS o
JOIN public.author AS a ON a.oid = o.oid
JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid
JOIN public.domain_publication AS dp ON dp.pid = w.pid
JOIN public.domain AS d ON d.did = dp.did
WHERE d.name = 'Machine Learning';

SELECT DISTINCT a.aid, a.name, a.homepage, a.oid
FROM public.author AS a
JOIN public.domain_author AS da ON da.aid = a.aid
WHERE da.did IN (
  SELECT da_m.did
  FROM public.author AS m
  JOIN public.domain_author AS da_m ON da_m.aid = m.aid
  WHERE m.name ILIKE '%Martin%'
)
ORDER BY a.name, a.aid;

SELECT DISTINCT p.pid, p.title, p.year, p.cid, c.name AS conference_name
FROM public.domain AS d
JOIN public.domain_author AS da ON da.did = d.did
JOIN public.author AS a ON a.aid = da.aid
JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid
JOIN public.publication AS p ON p.pid = w.pid
JOIN public.domain_conference AS dc ON dc.did = d.did
JOIN public.conference AS c ON c.cid = dc.cid
WHERE d.name ILIKE 'Sociology'
  AND p.year = 2020
  AND p.cid = c.cid;

SELECT DISTINCT a.name
FROM public.domain AS d
JOIN public.domain_author AS da ON da.did = d.did
JOIN public.author AS a ON a.aid = da.aid
JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.aid = a.aid
JOIN public.publication AS p ON p.pid = w.pid
WHERE d.name ILIKE 'Computer Science';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_of_students, DATE_TRUNC('month', admit_term)::date AS month FROM public.student WHERE admit_term IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', admit_term)::date ORDER BY no_of_students DESC, month LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(predicted_graduation_semester - admit_term) AS average_days_to_graduation FROM public.student WHERE predicted_graduation_semester IS NOT NULL AND admit_term IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS student_count
FROM public.student
WHERE predicted_graduation_semester >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 years'
  AND predicted_graduation_semester <= CURRENT_DATE;
SELECT (CURRENT_DATE - MAX(admit_term))::integer AS days_since_last_admitted_student FROM public.student WHERE admit_term IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT co.course_id
FROM public.course_offering AS co
JOIN public.offering_instructor AS oi
  ON oi.offering_id = co.offering_id
WHERE co.semester IN (1, 2)
  AND co.end_time < TIME '13:00:00'
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(co.thursday), '') IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c.course_id, COALESCE(SUM(ct.hilarious), 0) AS total_hilarious_students FROM public.course AS c LEFT JOIN public.course_tags_count AS ct ON ct.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id ORDER BY c.course_id;

SELECT i.instructor_id, i.name, i.uniqname, AVG(c.clarity_score) AS average_clarity_score
FROM public.instructor AS i
JOIN public.offering_instructor AS oi ON oi.instructor_id = i.instructor_id
JOIN public.course_offering AS co ON co.offering_id = oi.offering_id
JOIN public.course AS c ON c.course_id = co.course_id
WHERE c.clarity_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.instructor_id, i.name, i.uniqname
ORDER BY i.name, i.instructor_id;

SELECT has_final_exam, COUNT(*) AS offering_count
FROM public.course_offering
GROUP BY has_final_exam
ORDER BY has_final_exam DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS course_count
FROM public.course
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department;
SELECT semester AS semester_id, COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS course_count FROM public.course_offering GROUP BY semester ORDER BY semester;
SELECT course_id, name, num_enrolled FROM public.course WHERE num_enrolled IS NOT NULL ORDER BY num_enrolled DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS active_participants FROM public.student_record WHERE how = 'actively' GROUP BY course_id ORDER BY active_participants DESC, course_id;
SELECT course_id, name, num_enrolled AS total_students_enrolled FROM public.course ORDER BY num_enrolled DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT s.student_id, COALESCE(SUM(c.credits::numeric), 0) AS total_credits
FROM public.student AS s
LEFT JOIN public.student_record AS sr ON sr.student_id = s.student_id
LEFT JOIN public.course AS c ON c.course_id = sr.course_id
GROUP BY s.student_id
ORDER BY total_credits DESC, s.student_id;

SELECT i.name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.course_id) AS courses_taught
FROM public.instructor AS i
JOIN public.offering_instructor AS oi ON oi.instructor_id = i.instructor_id
JOIN public.course_offering AS co ON co.offering_id = oi.offering_id
GROUP BY i.instructor_id, i.name
ORDER BY courses_taught DESC, i.name
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_exams THEN num_enrolled ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT has_exams THEN num_enrolled ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enrollment_ratio FROM public.course;

SELECT c.course_id, COALESCE(t.clear_grading, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(t.good_feedback, 0), 0) AS clear_to_good_feedback_ratio FROM public.course AS c LEFT JOIN public.course_tags_count AS t ON t.course_id = c.course_id ORDER BY c.course_id;

SELECT co.semester AS semester_id, COUNT(DISTINCT co.course_id) FILTER (WHERE c.has_projects) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT co.course_id) FILTER (WHERE c.has_exams), 0) AS projects_to_exams_ratio FROM public.course_offering AS co JOIN public.course AS c ON c.course_id = co.course_id GROUP BY co.semester ORDER BY co.semester
SELECT course_id, helpfulness_score::numeric / NULLIF(clarity_score, 0) AS helpfulness_to_clarity_ratio FROM public.course ORDER BY course_id;
