SELECT course_id, name, num_enrolled, num_reviews, CASE WHEN num_reviews IS NULL OR num_reviews = 0 THEN NULL ELSE num_enrolled::numeric / num_reviews END AS enrolled_to_review_ratio FROM public.course ORDER BY enrolled_to_review_ratio DESC NULLS LAST, course_id;

SELECT DISTINCT c.course_id, c.name, c.department, c.number
FROM public.student AS s
JOIN public.program AS p ON p.program_id = s.program_id
JOIN public.student_record AS sr ON sr.student_id = s.student_id
JOIN public.course AS c ON c.course_id = sr.course_id
WHERE p.name = 'Computer Science'
ORDER BY c.course_id;

SELECT course_id, name, department, number
FROM public.course
WHERE has_projects = TRUE
  AND has_exams = TRUE;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sr.student_id) AS total_students
FROM public.student_record AS sr
JOIN public.course_offering AS co
  ON co.offering_id = sr.offering_id
WHERE co.has_final_project IS TRUE
   OR co.has_final_exam IS TRUE;

SELECT p.program_id, p.name AS program_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_credit), 0) AS total_credits_earned FROM public.program AS p LEFT JOIN public.student AS s ON s.program_id = p.program_id GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name ORDER BY p.program_id;

SELECT p.program_id, p.name AS program_name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS student_count
FROM public.program AS p
LEFT JOIN public.student AS s
  ON s.program_id = p.program_id
GROUP BY p.program_id, p.name
ORDER BY p.program_id;

SELECT firstname, lastname
FROM public.student
WHERE minor IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lastname;

SELECT AVG(s.total_gpa) AS average_gpa
FROM public.student AS s
JOIN public.program AS p ON p.program_id = s.program_id
WHERE LOWER(p.name) = LOWER('mathematics');
SELECT name FROM public.course WHERE department ILIKE 'Computer Science';
SELECT name, easiness_score FROM public.course WHERE department = 'Computer Science';

SELECT DISTINCT sr.student_id
FROM public.student_record AS sr
JOIN public.course_offering AS co
  ON co.offering_id = sr.offering_id
WHERE sr.grade IN ('A', 'C')
  AND co.class_address IS NOT NULL
  AND co.class_address <> '';

SELECT flight_id, from_airport, to_airport, departure_time, arrival_time, ((arrival_time / 100) * 60 + (arrival_time % 100)) - ((departure_time / 100) * 60 + (departure_time % 100)) AS duration_minutes FROM public.flight WHERE departure_time IS NOT NULL AND arrival_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY duration_minutes ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG((to_timestamp(arrival_time) - to_timestamp(departure_time)) / INTERVAL '1 minute') - 34 AS average_duration_minutes FROM public.flight WHERE departure_time IS NOT NULL AND arrival_time IS NOT NULL;

SELECT m.month_number, m.month_name, COUNT(*) AS departure_count
FROM public.month AS m
LEFT JOIN public.flight AS f
  ON POSITION(LPAD(m.month_number::text, 2, '0') IN f.flight_days) > 0
GROUP BY m.month_number, m.month_name
ORDER BY m.month_number;
SELECT to_char(make_time((MIN(departure_time) / 100)::int, (MIN(departure_time) % 100)::int, 0), 'HH24:MI') AS earliest_departure_time FROM public.flight WHERE departure_time IS NOT NULL;
SELECT ABS(CURRENT_DATE - TO_DATE(MIN(flight_days), 'YYYYMMDD'))::integer AS absolute_difference_days FROM public.flight WHERE flight_days ~ '^\\d{8}$';
SELECT f.fare_airline AS airline_code, SUM(f.round_trip_cost) AS total_round_trip_fare_cost FROM public.fare AS f GROUP BY f.fare_airline ORDER BY f.fare_airline;

SELECT f.fare_airline AS airline_code, a.airline_name, AVG(f.round_trip_cost) AS average_round_trip_cost FROM public.fare AS f LEFT JOIN public.airline AS a ON a.airline_code = f.fare_airline WHERE f.from_airport = 'LAX' AND f.to_airport = 'ORD' GROUP BY f.fare_airline, a.airline_name ORDER BY average_round_trip_cost DESC;

SELECT from_airport, to_airport, AVG(one_direction_cost) AS average_one_way_cost
FROM public.fare
GROUP BY from_airport, to_airport
ORDER BY from_airport, to_airport;

SELECT compartment, COUNT(*) AS meal_count
FROM public.food_service
GROUP BY compartment
ORDER BY meal_count DESC;

SELECT from_airport AS airport_code, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
FROM public.flight
WHERE COALESCE(connections, 0) = 0
GROUP BY from_airport
ORDER BY from_airport;
SELECT flight_id, time_elapsed FROM public.flight WHERE to_airport = 'ORD' AND time_elapsed = (SELECT MAX(time_elapsed) FROM public.flight WHERE to_airport = 'ORD') ORDER BY flight_id ASC;
SELECT airport_code, airport_name, minimum_connect_time FROM public.airport WHERE minimum_connect_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY minimum_connect_time ASC, airport_code ASC;
SELECT aircraft_code FROM public.aircraft WHERE pay_load = (SELECT MAX(pay_load) FROM public.aircraft);

SELECT a.airline_code, a.airline_name, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM public.flight f LEFT JOIN public.airline a ON a.airline_code = f.airline_code GROUP BY a.airline_code, a.airline_name ORDER BY flight_count DESC, a.airline_code LIMIT 2
SELECT aircraft_code FROM public.aircraft WHERE cruising_speed > 200 ORDER BY aircraft_code ASC;
SELECT aircraft_code, aircraft_description, MAX(range_miles)::numeric / NULLIF(MAX(pay_load), 0) AS range_to_max_payload_ratio FROM public.aircraft GROUP BY aircraft_code, aircraft_description;

SELECT fare_id, from_airport, to_airport, one_direction_cost, round_trip_cost, one_direction_cost::numeric / NULLIF(round_trip_cost, 0) AS one_way_to_round_trip_ratio FROM public.fare ORDER BY fare_id;
SELECT aircraft_code, capacity::numeric / NULLIF(range_miles, 0) AS capacity_to_range_ratio FROM public.aircraft ORDER BY aircraft_code;
SELECT airline_code, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stops > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS proportion_flights_with_stops FROM public.flight GROUP BY airline_code ORDER BY airline_code;

SELECT manufacturer, AVG(cruising_speed::numeric / NULLIF(pay_load, 0)) AS average_speed_to_payload_ratio FROM public.aircraft WHERE manufacturer IS NOT NULL AND cruising_speed IS NOT NULL AND pay_load IS NOT NULL AND pay_load <> 0 GROUP BY manufacturer ORDER BY manufacturer

SELECT DISTINCT f.flight_id, fs.meal_description
FROM public.flight AS f
JOIN public.food_service AS fs
  ON fs.meal_code = f.meal_code
JOIN public.compartment_class AS cc
  ON cc.compartment = fs.compartment
WHERE cc.class_type = 'First class';

SELECT DISTINCT al.airline_code, al.airline_name FROM public.airline AS al JOIN public.flight AS f ON f.airline_code = al.airline_code JOIN public.flight_stop AS fs ON fs.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN public.airport AS a ON a.airport_code = fs.stop_airport WHERE LOWER(a.airport_name) LIKE '%dallas%' OR LOWER(a.airport_location) LIKE '%dallas%' ORDER BY al.airline_name, al.airline_code;

SELECT DISTINCT a.airline_code, a.airline_name FROM public.flight AS f JOIN public.airline AS a ON a.airline_code = f.airline_code WHERE f.from_airport = 'LAX' AND f.to_airport = 'ORD' ORDER BY a.airline_name, a.airline_code;

SELECT a.airline_name, f.stops FROM public.flight AS f JOIN public.airline AS a ON a.airline_code = f.airline_code WHERE f.from_airport = 'ORD' AND f.to_airport = 'JFK' ORDER BY f.stops ASC, a.airline_name;

SELECT a.airline_code, a.airline_name
FROM public.airline AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM public.flight AS f
  WHERE f.airline_code = a.airline_code
    AND (f.from_airport = 'JFK' OR f.to_airport = 'JFK' OR f.stops > 0)
)
ORDER BY a.airline_code;
SELECT state_code FROM public.airport WHERE airport_name ILIKE '%Orlando International Airport%';
SELECT flight_number FROM public.flight WHERE flight_days ILIKE '%Monday%' AND flight_days ILIKE '%Wednesday%' ORDER BY flight_number;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.round_trip_cost), 0) AS total_round_trip_cost
FROM public.fare AS f
JOIN public.airport AS from_a ON from_a.airport_code = f.from_airport
JOIN public.airport AS to_a ON to_a.airport_code = f.to_airport
WHERE f.from_airport ILIKE 'JFK'
  AND from_a.airport_location ILIKE '%New York%'
  AND to_a.airport_location ILIKE '%Los Angeles%';
SELECT minimum_connect_time FROM public.airport WHERE airport_code = 'JFK' LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id) AS flight_count
FROM public.flight AS f
JOIN public.flight_fare AS ff ON ff.flight_id = f.flight_id
JOIN public.fare AS fa ON fa.fare_id = ff.fare_id
WHERE UPPER(fa.round_trip_required) IN ('Y', 'YES', 'TRUE');
SELECT country_name, SUM(population) AS total_population FROM public.city GROUP BY country_name ORDER BY country_name;
SELECT country_name, AVG(length) AS average_river_length FROM public.river GROUP BY country_name ORDER BY country_name;

SELECT country_name, COUNT(*) AS river_count
FROM public.river
WHERE country_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY country_name;

SELECT country_name, COUNT(*) AS mountain_count
FROM public.mountain
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY country_name;
SELECT state_name, COUNT(*) AS lake_count FROM public.lake GROUP BY state_name ORDER BY state_name;
SELECT state_name, density AS people_per_square_kilometer FROM public.state WHERE density IS NOT NULL ORDER BY density DESC;

SELECT lake_name, area AS area_square_kilometers
FROM public.lake
WHERE area IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY area DESC, lake_name;

SELECT city_name, population
FROM public.city
ORDER BY population DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;
SELECT river_name, length * 1000 AS length_meters FROM public.river ORDER BY length DESC;
SELECT mountain_name, mountain_altitude AS altitude_meters, country_name, state_name FROM public.mountain ORDER BY mountain_altitude DESC;
SELECT us.population::numeric / NULLIF(ca.population, 0) AS population_ratio FROM public.state AS us JOIN public.state AS ca ON ca.state_name = 'California' WHERE us.state_name = 'United States';

SELECT (MAX(length) FILTER (WHERE river_name = 'Mississippi')::numeric / NULLIF(MAX(length) FILTER (WHERE river_name = 'Rhine'), 0)) AS length_ratio FROM public.river WHERE river_name IN ('Mississippi', 'Rhine');

SELECT (MAX(mountain_altitude) FILTER (WHERE mountain_name = 'Mount Everest')::numeric / NULLIF(MAX(mountain_altitude) FILTER (WHERE mountain_name = 'Dhaulagiri'), 0)) AS altitude_ratio FROM public.mountain WHERE mountain_name IN ('Mount Everest', 'Dhaulagiri');

SELECT c.city_name, c.population::numeric / NULLIF(s.population, 0) AS city_to_state_population_proportion FROM public.city AS c JOIN public.state AS s ON c.state_name = s.state_name AND c.country_name = s.country_name;
SELECT state_name, population / NULLIF(area, 0) AS population_per_area FROM public.state;

SELECT DISTINCT l.country_name
FROM public.lake AS l
JOIN public.river AS r
  ON r.country_name = l.country_name
WHERE l.country_name IS NOT NULL
  AND r.country_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l.country_name;

SELECT DISTINCT bi.border
FROM public.lake AS l
JOIN public.border_info AS bi ON bi.state_name = l.state_name
WHERE LOWER(l.lake_name) = 'lake ontario'
  AND bi.border IS NOT NULL;

SELECT l.lake_name
FROM public.lake AS l
JOIN public.state AS s
  ON s.state_name = l.state_name
WHERE l.lake_name LIKE 'Lake%'
  AND s.area > 1000;
SELECT h.state_name, h.highest_point, s.density AS population_density FROM public.highlow AS h JOIN public.state AS s ON s.state_name = h.state_name ORDER BY h.state_name;
SELECT r.country_name, AVG(r.length) AS average_river_length FROM public.river AS r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lake AS l WHERE l.country_name = r.country_name) GROUP BY r.country_name;
SELECT state_name, population FROM public.state WHERE population < 100000;
SELECT river_name, traverse FROM public.river WHERE array_length(regexp_split_to_array(traverse, '\s*,\s*'), 1) >= 3;
SELECT lake_name, area FROM public.lake WHERE state_name ILIKE 'Michigan';
SELECT mountain_name, mountain_altitude FROM public.mountain WHERE country_name ILIKE 'Nepal';
SELECT city_name, population FROM public.city WHERE country_name ILIKE 'United States';

SELECT food_type, COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count
FROM public.restaurant
GROUP BY food_type
ORDER BY food_type;

SELECT city_name, COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count
FROM public.restaurant
GROUP BY city_name
ORDER BY city_name;

SELECT food_type, AVG(rating) AS average_rating
FROM public.restaurant
GROUP BY food_type
ORDER BY food_type;

SELECT city_name, COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count
FROM public.restaurant
WHERE food_type = 'Italian'
GROUP BY city_name
ORDER BY city_name;

SELECT city_name, COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count
FROM public.restaurant
GROUP BY city_name
ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC;

SELECT street_name, COUNT(DISTINCT restaurant_id) AS restaurant_count
FROM public.location
WHERE street_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY street_name
ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT id, name, food_type, city_name, rating FROM public.restaurant WHERE food_type = 'Italian' OR city_name = 'New York' ORDER BY name;

SELECT g.region, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
FROM public.restaurant AS r
JOIN public.geographic AS g ON r.city_name = g.city_name
GROUP BY g.region
ORDER BY g.region;
SELECT name FROM public.restaurant ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating > 4.5)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ratio FROM public.restaurant;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating > 4.0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating < 4.0), 0) AS ratio FROM public.restaurant;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating > 4)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating < 4), 0) AS ratio_above_to_below_4 FROM public.restaurant WHERE city_name = 'New York';

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE food_type ILIKE 'vegan')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE food_type NOT ILIKE 'vegan'), 0) AS vegan_to_non_vegan_ratio FROM public.restaurant WHERE city_name ILIKE 'San Francisco';
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(food_type) = 'italian')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS italian_ratio FROM public.restaurant WHERE LOWER(city_name) = 'los angeles';

SELECT city_name, name AS restaurant_name, COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count
FROM public.restaurant
GROUP BY city_name, name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY city_name, restaurant_name;
SELECT city_name, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM public.restaurant WHERE food_type = 'Mexican' GROUP BY city_name ORDER BY city_name;

SELECT g.region, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
FROM public.restaurant AS r
JOIN public.geographic AS g ON g.city_name = r.city_name
GROUP BY g.region
ORDER BY g.region;

SELECT g.region, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS restaurant_count
FROM public.restaurant AS r
JOIN public.geographic AS g ON g.city_name = r.city_name
WHERE r.food_type = 'Italian'
GROUP BY g.region
ORDER BY g.region;

SELECT g.region, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS restaurant_count
FROM public.restaurant AS r
JOIN public.geographic AS g
  ON r.city_name = g.city_name
GROUP BY g.region
ORDER BY g.region;
SELECT city_name, MAX(rating) AS highest_rating FROM public.restaurant WHERE city_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city_name ORDER BY highest_rating DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;

SELECT name, rating
FROM public.restaurant
WHERE rating > 4
  AND city_name ILIKE '%New York%';

SELECT r.name, r.food_type
FROM public.restaurant AS r
JOIN public.location AS l ON l.restaurant_id = r.id
WHERE l.street_name ILIKE '%Market St%'
  AND l.city_name ILIKE '%San Francisco%';
SELECT name FROM public.restaurant WHERE food_type ILIKE '%Italian%';

SELECT name
FROM public.restaurant
WHERE city_name ILIKE '%Los Angeles%'
  AND rating > 4;
SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS total_papers FROM public.paper GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS total_papers
FROM public.paper
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT d.datasetid, d.datasetname, COUNT(DISTINCT pd.paperid) AS paper_count
FROM public.dataset AS d
LEFT JOIN public.paperdataset AS pd ON pd.datasetid = d.datasetid
GROUP BY d.datasetid, d.datasetname
ORDER BY d.datasetid;

SELECT p.paperid, p.title, COUNT(DISTINCT pk.keyphraseid) AS keyphrase_count
FROM public.paper AS p
LEFT JOIN public.paperkeyphrase AS pk ON pk.paperid = p.paperid
GROUP BY p.paperid, p.title
ORDER BY p.paperid;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS author_count
FROM (
  SELECT authorid
  FROM public.writes
  GROUP BY authorid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT paperid) > 2
) AS prolific_authors;

SELECT p.paperid, p.title, COUNT(w.authorid) AS author_count
FROM public.paper AS p
LEFT JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.paperid = p.paperid
GROUP BY p.paperid, p.title
ORDER BY author_count DESC, p.paperid;

SELECT p.paperid, COUNT(pk.keyphraseid) AS total_keyphrases
FROM public.paper AS p
LEFT JOIN public.paperkeyphrase AS pk ON pk.paperid = p.paperid
GROUP BY p.paperid
ORDER BY p.paperid ASC;

SELECT title
FROM public.paper
WHERE year = 2020
ORDER BY title ASC;
SELECT journalname FROM public.journal ORDER BY length(journalname) ASC, journalname ASC;

SELECT citingpaperid AS paperid, COUNT(DISTINCT citedpaperid) AS papers_cited
FROM public.cite
GROUP BY citingpaperid
ORDER BY papers_cited DESC;

WITH keyphrase_counts AS (SELECT p.paperid, COUNT(pk.keyphraseid) AS keyphrase_count FROM public.paper AS p LEFT JOIN public.paperkeyphrase AS pk ON pk.paperid = p.paperid GROUP BY p.paperid) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE keyphrase_count > 1)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE keyphrase_count = 1), 0) AS ratio FROM keyphrase_counts;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(numcitedby, 0) >= 2)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(numcitedby, 0) < 2), 0) AS ratio FROM public.paper;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE year = 2020)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ratio_2020_to_total FROM public.paper;

WITH author_paper_counts AS (SELECT a.authorid, COUNT(DISTINCT w.paperid) AS paper_count FROM public.author AS a LEFT JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.authorid = a.authorid GROUP BY a.authorid) SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paper_count >= 3)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paper_count < 3), 0)) AS ratio FROM author_paper_counts;

WITH paper_dataset_counts AS (
  SELECT p.paperid, COUNT(pd.datasetid) AS dataset_count
  FROM public.paper AS p
  LEFT JOIN public.paperdataset AS pd ON pd.paperid = p.paperid
  GROUP BY p.paperid
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dataset_count > 1)::numeric
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dataset_count = 1), 0) AS proportion
FROM paper_dataset_counts;

SELECT DISTINCT p.paperid, p.title, p.year
FROM public.paper AS p
JOIN public.paperkeyphrase AS pk ON pk.paperid = p.paperid
JOIN public.keyphrase AS k ON k.keyphraseid = pk.keyphraseid
WHERE k.keyphrasename = 'Machine Learning'
ORDER BY p.year, p.paperid;

SELECT a.authorid, a.authorname, COUNT(DISTINCT w.paperid) AS paper_count
FROM public.author AS a
JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.authorid = a.authorid
GROUP BY a.authorid, a.authorname
ORDER BY paper_count DESC, a.authorid;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pk.keyphraseid) AS total_unique_keyphrases
FROM public.paper AS p
JOIN public.journal AS j ON j.journalid = p.journalid
JOIN public.paperkeyphrase AS pk ON pk.paperid = p.paperid
WHERE j.journalname ILIKE '%IEEE Transactions%';

SELECT j.journalname, COUNT(p.paperid) AS total_papers
FROM public.journal AS j
LEFT JOIN public.paper AS p ON p.journalid = j.journalid
GROUP BY j.journalid, j.journalname
ORDER BY j.journalname;

SELECT p.paperid, p.title, COUNT(c.citingpaperid) AS citing_paper_count
FROM public.paper AS p
JOIN public.paperdataset AS pd ON pd.paperid = p.paperid
JOIN public.dataset AS d ON d.datasetid = pd.datasetid
LEFT JOIN public.cite AS c ON c.citedpaperid = p.paperid
WHERE d.datasetname = 'COVID-19 Research'
GROUP BY p.paperid, p.title
ORDER BY p.paperid;

SELECT v.venuename, COUNT(p.paperid) AS total_papers FROM public.paper AS target JOIN public.venue AS v ON v.venueid = target.venueid JOIN public.paper AS p ON p.venueid = target.venueid WHERE target.paperid = 2 GROUP BY v.venuename;

SELECT a.authorname
FROM public.author AS a
JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.authorid = a.authorid
JOIN public.paper AS p ON p.paperid = w.paperid
WHERE p.title = 'The Effects of Climate Change on Agriculture';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS paper_count
FROM public.paper AS p
JOIN public.journal AS j ON j.journalid = p.journalid
WHERE LOWER(j.journalname) = LOWER('nature')
  AND p.year = 2020;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.paperid) AS paper_count
FROM public.paper AS p
JOIN public.journal AS j ON j.journalid = p.journalid
JOIN public.paperkeyphrase AS pk ON pk.paperid = p.paperid
JOIN public.keyphrase AS k ON k.keyphraseid = pk.keyphraseid
WHERE j.journalname = 'IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence'
  AND k.keyphrasename ILIKE 'machine learning';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.authorid) AS author_count
FROM public.paper AS p
JOIN public.journal AS j ON j.journalid = p.journalid
JOIN public.writes AS w ON w.paperid = p.paperid
WHERE LOWER(j.journalname) = LOWER('Science')
  AND p.year = 2020;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM public.review r
JOIN public.business b ON b.business_id = r.business_id
WHERE b.state = 'CA'
  AND make_date(r.year::int, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(r.month, 'Month'))::int, 1) >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '10 months'
  AND make_date(r.year::int, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(r.month, 'Month'))::int, 1) < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE);
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(count), 0) AS total_checkins FROM public.checkin WHERE LOWER(day) IN ('thursday', 'friday');

WITH target AS (SELECT year, month FROM public.review WHERE rid = 3), target_date AS (SELECT make_date(year::int, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM to_date(month, 'Month'))::int, 1) AS review_date FROM target) SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM public.review r CROSS JOIN target_date t WHERE make_date(r.year::int, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM to_date(r.month, 'Month'))::int, 1) = t.review_date - INTERVAL '2 months';
SELECT text AS message FROM public.tip WHERE year = 2021 AND month = 'May';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS months_with_reviews FROM public.review WHERE year = 2021 AND month IN ('June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December') AND month IS NOT NULL;

SELECT n.neighbourhood_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.business_id) AS business_count
FROM public.neighbourhood AS n
WHERE n.neighbourhood_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.neighbourhood_name
ORDER BY business_count DESC, n.neighbourhood_name;

SELECT day, SUM(count) AS total_checkins FROM public.checkin WHERE business_id = 'abc123' GROUP BY day ORDER BY CASE LOWER(day) WHEN 'monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'wednesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'saturday' THEN 6 WHEN 'sunday' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END, day;

SELECT b.name, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating FROM public.business AS b JOIN public.review AS r ON r.business_id = b.business_id WHERE LOWER(b.state) IN ('ny', 'new york') GROUP BY b.business_id, b.name;

SELECT day, SUM(count) AS total_checkins FROM public.checkin GROUP BY day ORDER BY CASE LOWER(day) WHEN 'sunday' THEN 1 WHEN 'monday' THEN 2 WHEN 'tuesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'wednesday' THEN 4 WHEN 'thursday' THEN 5 WHEN 'friday' THEN 6 WHEN 'saturday' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END, day;

SELECT b.name, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
FROM public.business AS b
JOIN public.review AS r ON r.business_id = b.business_id
WHERE b.state = 'NY'
GROUP BY b.business_id, b.name
ORDER BY average_rating DESC, b.name;

SELECT b.latitude, b.longitude FROM public.business AS b JOIN (SELECT business_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM public.review GROUP BY business_id ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 1) AS r ON r.business_id = b.business_id;
SELECT business_id, name, review_count FROM public.business ORDER BY review_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3;
SELECT name FROM public.business ORDER BY name ASC;

SELECT month, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM public.review WHERE year = 2021 GROUP BY month ORDER BY CASE LOWER(month) WHEN 'january' THEN 1 WHEN 'february' THEN 2 WHEN 'march' THEN 3 WHEN 'april' THEN 4 WHEN 'may' THEN 5 WHEN 'june' THEN 6 WHEN 'july' THEN 7 WHEN 'august' THEN 8 WHEN 'september' THEN 9 WHEN 'october' THEN 10 WHEN 'november' THEN 11 WHEN 'december' THEN 12 ELSE 13 END, month;
SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS business_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) AS business_ratio FROM public.business GROUP BY state ORDER BY state
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_open = 1)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_open = 0), 0) AS open_to_closed_ratio FROM public.business WHERE city = 'San Francisco';

WITH daily AS (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(day)) AS day, SUM(COALESCE(count, 0)) AS checkins FROM public.checkin c JOIN public.business b ON b.business_id = c.business_id WHERE b.name = 'Mark’s Bistro' GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(day))) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(checkins) FILTER (WHERE day IN ('saturday','sunday')), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(checkins) FILTER (WHERE day IN ('monday','tuesday','wednesday','thursday','friday')), 0), 0) AS weekend_to_weekday_ratio FROM daily;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'CA')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'NY'), 0) AS california_to_new_york_ratio FROM public.business;

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.rating > 3)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.rating < 3), 0) AS positive_to_negative_ratio FROM public.category AS c JOIN public.review AS r ON r.business_id = c.business_id WHERE r.rating > 3 OR r.rating < 3 GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY positive_to_negative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT r.user_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM public.review AS r JOIN public.neighbourhood AS n ON n.business_id = r.business_id WHERE n.neighbourhood_name = 'Downtown' GROUP BY r.user_id ORDER BY review_count DESC, r.user_id;

SELECT c.category_name, SUM(COALESCE(b.review_count, 0)) AS total_reviews
FROM public.business AS b
JOIN public.category AS c ON c.business_id = b.business_id
WHERE b.state = 'California'
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY c.category_name;
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(r.rid) AS total_reviews FROM public.category AS c LEFT JOIN public.review AS r ON r.business_id = c.business_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_name;

SELECT b.business_id, b.name, COALESCE(SUM(c.count), 0) AS total_checkins FROM public.business AS b LEFT JOIN public.checkin AS c ON c.business_id = b.business_id WHERE b.state = 'CA' GROUP BY b.business_id, b.name ORDER BY b.business_id;

SELECT c.category_name, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating FROM public.category AS c JOIN public.review AS r ON r.business_id = c.business_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY average_rating DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews
FROM public.review r
JOIN public.category c ON c.business_id = r.business_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Cafe'
  AND r.year = 2021;

SELECT AVG(business_avg_rating) AS average_rating
FROM (
  SELECT b.business_id, AVG(r.rating) AS business_avg_rating
  FROM public.business AS b
  JOIN public.review AS r ON r.business_id = b.business_id
  WHERE b.city ILIKE '%San Francisco%'
  GROUP BY b.business_id
) AS business_ratings;

SELECT business_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM public.review
WHERE year = 2021
GROUP BY business_id
ORDER BY business_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM public.review r
JOIN public.users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id
WHERE u.name ILIKE '%Sarah Williams%'
  AND r.year = 2021
  AND r.month ILIKE '%April%';
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.count), 0) AS monday_checkins FROM public.checkin AS c JOIN public.business AS b ON b.business_id = c.business_id WHERE b.state = 'CA' AND c.day ILIKE '%Monday%';

SELECT c.sbcustid AS id, c.sbcustname AS name, COUNT(*) AS number_of_transactions
FROM public.sbtransaction t
JOIN public.sbcustomer c ON c.sbcustid = t.sbtxcustid
WHERE t.sbtxtype = 'SELL'
  AND t.sbtxdatetime >= TIMESTAMP '2023-04-01 00:00:00'
  AND t.sbtxdatetime < TIMESTAMP '2023-04-02 00:00:00'
GROUP BY c.sbcustid, c.sbcustname
ORDER BY number_of_transactions DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', sbtxdatetime)::date AS month, AVG(sbtxprice) AS monthly_average_transaction_price FROM public.sbtransaction WHERE sbtxstatus = 'successful' AND sbtxdatetime >= TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01' AND sbtxdatetime < TIMESTAMP '2023-04-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', sbtxdatetime) ORDER BY month;

SELECT dp.sbdpdate, dp.sbdpclose AS closest_price FROM public.sbdailyprice AS dp JOIN public.sbticker AS t ON t.sbtickerid = dp.sbdptickerid WHERE t.sbtickersymbol = 'VTI' AND dp.sbdpdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' AND dp.sbdpdate <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY dp.sbdpclose ASC, dp.sbdpdate DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.sbcustid, MIN(t.sbtxdatetime)::date - c.sbcustjoindate AS days_to_first_transaction
FROM public.sbcustomer AS c
JOIN public.sbtransaction AS t ON t.sbtxcustid = c.sbcustid
GROUP BY c.sbcustid, c.sbcustjoindate;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM public.sbtransaction AS t
JOIN public.sbcustomer AS c ON c.sbcustid = t.sbtxcustid
WHERE c.sbcustjoindate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '70 days';

SELECT t.treatment_id, t.start_dt AS treatment_start_date, ae.reported_dt AS adverse_event_date, ae.description FROM public.treatments AS t JOIN public.adverse_events AS ae ON ae.treatment_id = t.treatment_id WHERE ae.reported_dt > t.start_dt AND ae.reported_dt <= t.start_dt + INTERVAL '10 days';

SELECT d.last_name, d.year_reg, t.start_dt AS first_treatment_date, t.treatment_id AS first_treatment_id
FROM public.doctors AS d
JOIN public.treatments AS t ON t.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE d.year_reg = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::integer - 2
  AND t.start_dt = (
    SELECT MIN(t2.start_dt)
    FROM public.treatments AS t2
    WHERE t2.doc_id = d.doc_id
  )
ORDER BY d.last_name, t.treatment_id;
SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, date_of_birth))) AS average_age FROM public.patients WHERE LOWER(gender) = 'male' AND LOWER(ins_type) = 'private';

SELECT t.treatment_id, t.start_dt AS treatment_start_dt, t.end_dt AS treatment_end_dt, cm.start_dt AS concomitant_start_dt, cm.end_dt AS concomitant_end_dt FROM public.treatments AS t JOIN public.concomitant_meds AS cm ON cm.treatment_id = t.treatment_id WHERE t.is_placebo = TRUE AND NULLIF(cm.start_dt, '')::date BETWEEN t.start_dt AND t.start_dt + INTERVAL '14 days';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS treatment_count
FROM public.treatments AS t
JOIN public.diagnoses AS d ON d.diag_id = t.diag_id
JOIN public.drugs AS dr ON dr.drug_id = t.drug_id
WHERE d.diag_name ILIKE '%psoriasis%'
  AND dr.fda_appr_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND t.end_dt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months'
  AND t.end_dt <= CURRENT_DATE;

SELECT AVG(tx_limit_daily) AS average_daily_limit, AVG(tx_limit_monthly) AS average_monthly_limit FROM consumer_div.user_setting_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MIN(snapshot_date) FROM consumer_div.user_setting_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND snapshot_date < DATE '2024-01-01');

SELECT u.username, u.email, u.created_at::date AS signup_date
FROM consumer_div.users AS u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM consumer_div.notifications AS n
  WHERE n.user_id = u.uid
    AND n.created_at >= u.created_at
    AND n.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '1 year'
);

SELECT device_type, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (session_end_ts - session_start_ts))) AS average_session_duration_seconds FROM consumer_div.user_sessions WHERE session_start_ts IS NOT NULL AND session_end_ts IS NOT NULL AND session_end_ts >= session_start_ts GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY device_type;

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY w.balance) AS median_merchant_wallet_balance FROM consumer_div.wallet_merchant_balance_daily AS w JOIN consumer_div.merchants AS m ON m.mid = w.merchant_id WHERE m.status = 'active' AND m.category ILIKE '%retail%' AND w.updated_at::date = CURRENT_DATE;

WITH earliest_coupons AS (
  SELECT
    c.merchant_id,
    c.cid AS earliest_coupon_id,
    c.start_date AS earliest_coupon_start_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.merchant_id
      ORDER BY c.start_date, c.cid
    ) AS rn
  FROM consumer_div.coupons AS c
  WHERE c.start_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  m.mid AS merchant_id,
  m.created_at::date AS registration_date,
  ec.earliest_coupon_id,
  ec.earliest_coupon_start_date
FROM consumer_div.merchants AS m
JOIN earliest_coupons AS ec
  ON ec.merchant_id = m.mid
 AND ec.rn = 1
WHERE ec.earliest_coupon_start_date BETWEEN m.created_at::date
  AND (m.created_at::date + INTERVAL '1 year')::date
ORDER BY m.mid

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', first_name, last_name) AS name, phone, (termination_date - hire_date) AS employment_days FROM public.salespersons WHERE hire_date IS NOT NULL AND termination_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (termination_date - hire_date) ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS weekend_payment_count
FROM public.payments_made
WHERE vendor_name = 'Utility Company'
  AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM payment_date) IN (6, 7);

SELECT payment_date, payment_method, SUM(payment_amount) AS total_payment_amount FROM public.payments_received WHERE payment_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)::date - INTERVAL '7 days' AND payment_date < date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)::date GROUP BY payment_date, payment_method ORDER BY payment_date, payment_method;

SELECT c.id AS car_id, c.make, c.model, c.year
FROM public.inventory_snapshots AS i
JOIN public.cars AS c ON c.id = i.car_id
WHERE i.snapshot_date = (
  SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
  FROM public.inventory_snapshots
  WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE '2023-03-01'
    AND snapshot_date < DATE '2023-04-01'
)
  AND i.is_in_inventory IS TRUE
  AND i.snapshot_date >= DATE '2023-03-01'
  AND i.snapshot_date < DATE '2023-04-01';

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.sale_date)::date AS quarter_start, c.state, SUM(s.sale_price) AS total_sales FROM public.sales AS s JOIN public.customers AS c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE s.sale_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND s.sale_date < DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.sale_date)::date, c.state ORDER BY quarter_start, c.state;

SELECT c.sbcustname AS customer_name, SUM(t.sbtxamount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM public.sbcustomer AS c
JOIN public.sbtransaction AS t ON t.sbtxcustid = c.sbcustid
GROUP BY c.sbcustid, c.sbcustname
ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT t.sbtickersymbol AS ticker_symbol, COUNT(*) AS buy_transaction_count
FROM public.sbtransaction AS x
JOIN public.sbticker AS t ON t.sbtickerid = x.sbtxtickerid
WHERE LOWER(x.sbtxtype) = 'buy'
  AND x.sbtxdatetime >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '10 days'
GROUP BY t.sbtickersymbol
ORDER BY buy_transaction_count DESC, t.sbtickersymbol
LIMIT 2;

SELECT c.sbcustname AS customer_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(t.sbtxstatus) = 'successful') / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate FROM public.sbcustomer AS c JOIN public.sbtransaction AS t ON t.sbtxcustid = c.sbcustid GROUP BY c.sbcustid, c.sbcustname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY success_rate ASC, customer_name ASC;

SELECT t.sbtickersymbol AS ticker_symbol, MAX(p.sbdphigh) - MIN(p.sbdplow) AS price_change FROM public.sbdailyprice AS p JOIN public.sbticker AS t ON t.sbtickerid = p.sbdptickerid WHERE p.sbdpdate BETWEEN DATE '2023-04-01' AND DATE '2023-04-04' GROUP BY t.sbtickersymbol ORDER BY price_change DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

WITH monthly AS (SELECT t.sbtickersymbol AS ticker_symbol, date_trunc('month', p.sbdpdate)::date AS month, AVG(p.sbdpclose) AS average_closing_price, MAX(p.sbdphigh) AS highest_price, MIN(p.sbdplow) AS lowest_price FROM public.sbdailyprice p JOIN public.sbticker t ON t.sbtickerid = p.sbdptickerid GROUP BY t.sbtickersymbol, date_trunc('month', p.sbdpdate)), with_previous AS (SELECT ticker_symbol, month, average_closing_price, highest_price, lowest_price, LAG(average_closing_price) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker_symbol ORDER BY month) AS previous_average_closing_price FROM monthly) SELECT ticker_symbol, month, average_closing_price, highest_price, lowest_price, (average_closing_price - previous_average_closing_price) / NULLIF(previous_average_closing_price, 0) AS momc FROM with_previous ORDER BY ticker_symbol, month

WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.sbcustid, c.sbcustname, COUNT(t.sbtxid) AS number_of_transactions, COALESCE(SUM(t.sbtxamount), 0) AS total_transaction_amount FROM public.sbcustomer AS c LEFT JOIN public.sbtransaction AS t ON t.sbtxcustid = c.sbcustid GROUP BY c.sbcustid, c.sbcustname) SELECT sbcustname AS customer_name, number_of_transactions, total_transaction_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC) AS cr FROM customer_totals ORDER BY cr, customer_name;

WITH signup_months AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', sbcustjoindate)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS pmcs FROM public.sbcustomer WHERE sbcustjoindate >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '6 months' AND sbcustjoindate < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1), transaction_months AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', t.sbtxdatetime)::date AS month, AVG(t.sbtxamount) AS pmat FROM public.sbtransaction t JOIN public.sbcustomer c ON c.sbcustid = t.sbtxcustid WHERE c.sbcustjoindate >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '6 months' AND c.sbcustjoindate < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.month, s.pmcs, tm.pmat FROM signup_months s LEFT JOIN transaction_months tm ON tm.month = s.month ORDER BY s.month

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.sbtxamount), 0) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM public.sbtransaction AS t
JOIN public.sbcustomer AS c
  ON c.sbcustid = t.sbtxcustid
WHERE c.sbcustcountry = 'USA'
  AND t.sbtxdatetime >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 week'
  AND t.sbtxdatetime < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE);

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', current_date)::date AS current_week
), weeks AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    (SELECT current_week FROM bounds) - INTERVAL '8 weeks',
    (SELECT current_week FROM bounds) - INTERVAL '1 week',
    INTERVAL '1 week'
  )::date AS week_start
), stock_transactions AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('week', t.sbtxdatetime)::date AS week_start,
    COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM t.sbtxdatetime) IN (6, 7)) AS weekend_transactions
  FROM public.sbtransaction AS t
  JOIN public.sbticker AS s
    ON s.sbtickerid = t.sbtxtickerid
  CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
  WHERE s.sbtickertype ILIKE 'stock%'
    AND t.sbtxdatetime >= b.current_week - INTERVAL '8 weeks'
    AND t.sbtxdatetime < b.current_week
  GROUP BY date_trunc('week', t.sbtxdatetime)::date
)
SELECT
  w.week_start,
  COALESCE(st.total_transactions, 0) AS total_transactions,
  COALESCE(st.weekend_transactions, 0) AS weekend_transactions
FROM weeks AS w
LEFT JOIN stock_transactions AS st
  ON st.week_start = w.week_start
ORDER BY w.week_start;

WITH customer_transaction_counts AS (SELECT c.sbcustid AS customer_id, c.sbcustname AS customer_name, COUNT(t.sbtxid) AS transaction_count FROM public.sbcustomer c JOIN public.sbtransaction t ON t.sbtxcustid = c.sbcustid AND DATE_TRUNC('month', t.sbtxdatetime) = DATE_TRUNC('month', c.sbcustjoindate) GROUP BY c.sbcustid, c.sbcustname) SELECT customer_id, customer_name, transaction_count FROM customer_transaction_counts ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, customer_id LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tr.sbtxcustid) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM public.sbtransaction AS tr
JOIN public.sbcustomer AS c ON c.sbcustid = tr.sbtxcustid
JOIN public.sbticker AS t ON t.sbtickerid = tr.sbtxtickerid
WHERE LOWER(c.sbcustemail) LIKE '%.com'
  AND UPPER(t.sbtickersymbol) IN ('AMZN', 'AAPL', 'GOOGL', 'META', 'NFLX')
  AND (tr.sbtxshares > 0 OR UPPER(tr.sbtxtype) IN ('BUY', 'PURCHASE'))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM public.sbcustomer
WHERE (sbcustname ILIKE 'J%' OR sbcustname ILIKE '%ez')
  AND sbcuststate ILIKE '%a';

SELECT sbcustcountry AS country, COUNT(*) AS tac_count
FROM public.sbcustomer
WHERE sbcustjoindate >= DATE '2023-01-01'
  AND sbcuststatus = 'Active'
GROUP BY sbcustcountry
ORDER BY sbcustcountry

SELECT t.sbtickertype AS ticker_type, AVG(p.sbdpclose) AS average_closing_price FROM public.sbdailyprice AS p JOIN public.sbticker AS t ON t.sbtickerid = p.sbdptickerid WHERE p.sbdpdate BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days' AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY t.sbtickertype ORDER BY t.sbtickertype;

WITH customers_with_transactions AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.sbcustid, c.sbcustcountry, c.sbcuststatus FROM public.sbcustomer c JOIN public.sbtransaction t ON t.sbtxcustid = c.sbcustid WHERE c.sbcustjoindate >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND c.sbcustjoindate < DATE '2023-01-01'), country_counts AS (SELECT sbcustcountry, COUNT(*) AS total_customers_with_transactions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(sbcuststatus, '')) = 'active') AS active_customers_with_transactions FROM customers_with_transactions GROUP BY sbcustcountry) SELECT sbcustcountry AS country, 100.0 * active_customers_with_transactions / NULLIF(total_customers_with_transactions, 0) AS ar FROM country_counts ORDER BY sbcustcountry

SELECT tk.sbtickersymbol AS ticker_symbol, CASE WHEN SUM(t.sbtxamount) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(t.sbtxamount) - (SUM(COALESCE(t.sbtxtax, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(t.sbtxcommission, 0)))) / SUM(t.sbtxamount) * 100 END AS spm FROM public.sbtransaction AS t JOIN public.sbticker AS tk ON tk.sbtickerid = t.sbtxtickerid WHERE LOWER(t.sbtxtype) = 'sell' AND t.sbtxdatetime >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 month' AND t.sbtxdatetime <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY tk.sbtickersymbol ORDER BY tk.sbtickersymbol

WITH latest_payments AS (SELECT sale_id, MAX(payment_date) AS latest_payment_date FROM public.payments_received GROUP BY sale_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(latest_payment_date - sale_date)::numeric, 2) AS average_days_between_sale_and_payment FROM public.sales s JOIN latest_payments lp ON lp.sale_id = s.id WHERE s.sale_date IS NOT NULL AND lp.latest_payment_date IS NOT NULL;

WITH latest_inventory AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (car_id)
    car_id,
    is_in_inventory
  FROM public.inventory_snapshots
  ORDER BY car_id, snapshot_date DESC, crtd_ts DESC, id DESC
), highest_sales AS (
  SELECT
    c.make,
    c.model,
    MAX(s.sale_price) AS highest_sale_price
  FROM public.sales AS s
  JOIN public.cars AS c ON c.id = s.car_id
  JOIN latest_inventory AS li ON li.car_id = c.id
  WHERE li.is_in_inventory = FALSE
  GROUP BY c.make, c.model
)
SELECT make, model, highest_sale_price
FROM highest_sales
ORDER BY highest_sale_price DESC;

SELECT sp.id, sp.first_name, sp.last_name, SUM(s.sale_price) AS total_sales_amount
FROM public.salespersons AS sp
JOIN public.sales AS s ON s.salesperson_id = sp.id
GROUP BY sp.id, sp.first_name, sp.last_name
ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, sp.id ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

SELECT sp.id, sp.first_name, sp.last_name, COUNT(s.id) AS number_of_sales
FROM public.salespersons AS sp
LEFT JOIN public.sales AS s
  ON s.salesperson_id = sp.id
 AND s.sale_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '29 days' AND CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY sp.id, sp.first_name, sp.last_name
ORDER BY number_of_sales DESC, sp.id;

WITH salesperson_totals AS (SELECT sp.id, sp.first_name, sp.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.sale_price), 0) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.id) AS number_of_sales FROM public.salespersons sp LEFT JOIN public.sales s ON s.salesperson_id = sp.id GROUP BY sp.id, sp.first_name, sp.last_name) SELECT first_name, last_name, total_sales_amount, number_of_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC) AS sr FROM salesperson_totals ORDER BY sr, last_name, first_name;

WITH monthly_payments AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', payment_date)::date AS month,
    SUM(payment_amount) AS total_payments_received
  FROM public.payments_received
  GROUP BY 1
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(month) AS min_month,
    MAX(month) AS max_month
  FROM monthly_payments
), all_months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(min_month, max_month, interval '1 month')::date AS month
  FROM bounds
), monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    m.month,
    COALESCE(p.total_payments_received, 0) AS total_payments_received
  FROM all_months m
  LEFT JOIN monthly_payments p ON p.month = m.month
)
SELECT
  month,
  total_payments_received,
  total_payments_received - LAG(total_payments_received) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_change
FROM monthly_totals
ORDER BY month;

WITH months AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '6 months', date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month', interval '1 month')::date AS month), eligible_salespersons AS (SELECT id FROM public.salespersons WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND hire_date < DATE '2024-01-01'), monthly_sales AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', s.sale_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS pmsps, COALESCE(SUM(s.sale_price), 0) AS pmsr FROM public.sales s JOIN eligible_salespersons esp ON esp.id = s.salesperson_id WHERE s.sale_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '6 months' AND s.sale_date < date_trunc('month', current_date) GROUP BY date_trunc('month', s.sale_date)) SELECT m.month, COALESCE(ms.pmsps, 0) AS pmsps, COALESCE(ms.pmsr, 0) AS pmsr FROM months m LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms ON ms.month = m.month ORDER BY m.month ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS number_of_sales, COALESCE(SUM(s.sale_price), 0) AS total_revenue FROM public.sales AS s JOIN public.cars AS c ON c.id = s.car_id WHERE c.make = 'Toyota' AND s.sale_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND CURRENT_DATE;

WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)::date - INTERVAL '8 weeks',
    date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)::date - INTERVAL '1 week',
    INTERVAL '1 week'
  )::date AS week
), qualifying_sales AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.sales
  WHERE sale_price > 30000
), payment_counts AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', pr.payment_date)::date AS week,
         COUNT(*) AS total_payments,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM pr.payment_date) IN (0, 6)) AS weekend_payments
  FROM public.payments_received pr
  JOIN qualifying_sales qs ON qs.id = pr.sale_id
  WHERE pr.payment_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)::date - INTERVAL '8 weeks'
    AND pr.payment_date < date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)::date
  GROUP BY date_trunc('week', pr.payment_date)::date
)
SELECT w.week,
       COALESCE(pc.total_payments, 0) AS total_payments_received,
       COALESCE(pc.weekend_payments, 0) AS weekend_payments_received
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN payment_counts pc ON pc.week = w.week
ORDER BY w.week ASC

SELECT c.make, c.model, s.sale_price FROM public.inventory_snapshots AS i JOIN public.sales AS s ON i.car_id = s.car_id AND DATE_TRUNC('day', i.snapshot_date) = DATE_TRUNC('day', s.sale_date) JOIN public.cars AS c ON c.id = s.car_id WHERE i.is_in_inventory = FALSE ORDER BY s.sale_price DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT c.make, c.model, c.year, c.color, c.vin_number, AVG(s.sale_price) AS avg_sale_price
FROM public.cars AS c
JOIN public.sales AS s ON s.car_id = c.id
WHERE c.make ILIKE '%Ford%'
   OR c.model ILIKE '%Mustang%'
GROUP BY c.id, c.make, c.model, c.year, c.color, c.vin_number
ORDER BY c.make, c.model, c.year, c.vin_number;

SELECT c.make, c.model, COUNT(s.id) AS number_of_sales
FROM public.cars AS c
JOIN public.sales AS s ON s.car_id = c.id
WHERE c.vin_number ILIKE '%M5%'
GROUP BY c.make, c.model
ORDER BY c.make, c.model;
SELECT AVG(sale_price) AS asp FROM public.sales WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND sale_date < DATE '2023-04-01';

SELECT sp.first_name, sp.last_name, SUM(s.sale_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(s.id), 0) AS asp FROM public.salespersons AS sp JOIN public.sales AS s ON s.salesperson_id = sp.id GROUP BY sp.id, sp.first_name, sp.last_name ORDER BY asp DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT ((SUM(s.sale_price) - SUM(c.cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(c.cost), 0)) * 100 AS gpm_percentage FROM public.sales AS s JOIN public.cars AS c ON c.id = s.car_id WHERE s.sale_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND s.sale_date < DATE '2024-01-01';

SELECT DISTINCT d.loc_state AS state
FROM public.doctors AS d
JOIN public.treatments AS t ON t.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN public.drugs AS dr ON dr.drug_id = t.drug_id
WHERE dr.drug_type = 'biologic'
  AND d.loc_state IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(p.weight_kg) AS average_weight_kg
FROM public.patients AS p
JOIN public.treatments AS t ON t.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN public.drugs AS d ON d.drug_id = t.drug_id
WHERE d.drug_name = 'Drugalin';

SELECT ae.description, t.treatment_id, d.drug_id, d.drug_name
FROM public.treatments AS t
JOIN public.adverse_events AS ae ON ae.treatment_id = t.treatment_id
JOIN public.drugs AS d ON d.drug_id = t.drug_id
WHERE LOWER(d.admin_route) = 'topical';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.patient_id) AS patient_count
FROM public.patients AS p
JOIN public.treatments AS t ON t.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN public.diagnoses AS d ON d.diag_id = t.diag_id
JOIN public.drugs AS dr ON dr.drug_id = t.drug_id
WHERE d.diag_name = 'Psoriasis vulgaris'
  AND LOWER(dr.drug_type) = 'biologic';

WITH first_treatments AS (
  SELECT patient_id, MIN(start_dt) AS first_start_dt
  FROM public.treatments
  GROUP BY patient_id
), annual_new_patients AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ft.first_start_dt)::integer AS year,
         COUNT(p.patient_id)::integer AS new_patients
  FROM first_treatments ft
  JOIN public.patients p ON p.patient_id = ft.patient_id
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ft.first_start_dt)
), with_previous AS (
  SELECT year,
         new_patients,
         LAG(new_patients) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS previous_year_new_patients
  FROM annual_new_patients
)
SELECT year,
       new_patients,
       new_patients - previous_year_new_patients AS npi
FROM with_previous
ORDER BY year;

SELECT d.doc_id, d.specialty, COUNT(DISTINCT t.drug_id) AS distinct_drugs_prescribed, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.specialty ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.drug_id) DESC) AS sdr FROM public.doctors AS d LEFT JOIN public.treatments AS t ON t.doc_id = d.doc_id GROUP BY d.doc_id, d.specialty

SELECT COUNT(*) AS treatment_count
FROM public.treatments AS t
JOIN public.patients AS p ON p.patient_id = t.patient_id
WHERE p.first_name = 'Alice'
  AND t.start_dt >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '6 months'
  AND t.start_dt < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE);

WITH months AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '12 months', date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month', INTERVAL '1 month')::date AS month_start), monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', t.start_dt)::date AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT t.patient_id) AS pmpd, COUNT(t.treatment_id) AS pmtc FROM public.treatments t WHERE t.start_dt >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '12 months' AND t.start_dt < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY date_trunc('month', t.start_dt)::date) SELECT m.month_start, COALESCE(x.pmpd, 0) AS pmpd, COALESCE(x.pmtc, 0) AS pmtc FROM months m LEFT JOIN monthly x ON x.month_start = m.month_start ORDER BY m.month_start;

WITH months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months',
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month',
    INTERVAL '1 month'
  )::date AS month
), monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', t.start_dt)::date AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.patient_id) AS patient_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.patient_id) FILTER (WHERE d.drug_type = 'biologic') AS biologic_treatment_count
  FROM public.treatments AS t
  LEFT JOIN public.drugs AS d ON d.drug_id = t.drug_id
  WHERE t.start_dt >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months'
    AND t.start_dt < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', t.start_dt)::date
)
SELECT
  m.month,
  COALESCE(x.patient_count, 0) AS patient_count,
  COALESCE(x.biologic_treatment_count, 0) AS biologic_treatment_count
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN monthly AS x ON x.month = m.month
ORDER BY m.month

SELECT d.drug_id, d.drug_name, COUNT(ae.id) AS adverse_event_count FROM public.treatments AS t JOIN public.drugs AS d ON d.drug_id = t.drug_id JOIN public.adverse_events AS ae ON DATE_TRUNC('month', ae.reported_dt) = DATE_TRUNC('month', t.start_dt) GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.drug_name ORDER BY adverse_event_count DESC, d.drug_id LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM public.patients
WHERE email ILIKE '%@gmail.%'
   OR email ILIKE '%@yahoo.%';

SELECT first_name, last_name, specialty
FROM public.doctors
WHERE first_name ILIKE 'J%'
   OR last_name ILIKE '%son%';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pic FROM public.patients WHERE gender = 'Female' AND ins_type = 'Private';
SELECT AVG(weight_kg) AS caw_kg FROM public.patients WHERE LOWER(gender) = 'male';

SELECT d.drug_name, AVG(t.tot_drug_amt / NULLIF((t.end_dt - t.start_dt)::numeric, 0)) AS average_ddd
FROM public.treatments AS t
JOIN public.drugs AS d ON d.drug_id = t.drug_id
WHERE t.end_dt IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.drug_name;

SELECT ((AVG(day100_pasi_score) - AVG(day7_pasi_score)) / NULLIF(AVG(day7_pasi_score), 0) * 100) AS d7d100pir_percentage FROM public.outcomes WHERE day7_pasi_score IS NOT NULL AND day100_pasi_score IS NOT NULL;

WITH user_transactions AS (SELECT u.uid AS user_id, w.txid FROM consumer_div.users AS u JOIN consumer_div.wallet_transactions_daily AS w ON w.sender_id = u.uid WHERE w.sender_type <> 1) SELECT user_id, COUNT(txid) AS total_transaction_count FROM user_transactions GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id

SELECT c.cid AS coupon_id, COALESCE(SUM(w.amount), 0) AS total_amount_transacted
FROM consumer_div.coupons AS c
LEFT JOIN consumer_div.wallet_transactions_daily AS w
  ON w.coupon_id = c.cid
WHERE c.merchant_id = 1
GROUP BY c.cid
ORDER BY c.cid;

WITH user_session_data AS (
  SELECT
    u.uid AS user_id,
    us.session_start_ts,
    us.session_end_ts
  FROM consumer_div.users AS u
  JOIN consumer_div.user_sessions AS us
    ON u.uid = us.user_id
  WHERE us.session_start_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2023-06-01'
    AND us.session_start_ts < TIMESTAMP '2023-06-08'
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (session_end_ts - session_start_ts)))::bigint AS total_duration_seconds
FROM user_session_data
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY total_duration_seconds DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.uid) u.uid AS user_id, uss.marketing_opt_in AS marketing_opt_in
FROM consumer_div.users AS u
LEFT JOIN consumer_div.user_setting_snapshot AS uss
  ON uss.user_id = u.uid
ORDER BY u.uid, uss.snapshot_date DESC NULLS LAST, uss.created_at DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT user_id, balance AS lub FROM (SELECT user_id, balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM consumer_div.wallet_user_balance_daily) AS latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY user_id;

SELECT m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, COALESCE(SUM(w.amount), 0) AS revenue_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(w.amount), 0) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM consumer_div.merchants AS m LEFT JOIN consumer_div.wallet_transactions_daily AS w ON w.receiver_id = m.mid AND w.receiver_type = 1 AND LOWER(w.status) = 'success' GROUP BY m.mid, m.name, m.category ORDER BY revenue_rank, merchant_name;

WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) AS current_week), weeks AS (SELECT generate_series(b.current_week - interval '3 weeks', b.current_week - interval '1 week', interval '1 week') AS week_start FROM bounds b), counts AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', n.created_at) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS total_notifications, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM n.created_at) IN (6, 7)) AS weekend_notifications FROM consumer_div.notifications n JOIN consumer_div.users u ON u.uid = n.user_id CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE u.country IN ('US', 'Canada') AND n.created_at >= b.current_week - interval '3 weeks' AND n.created_at < b.current_week GROUP BY date_trunc('week', n.created_at)) SELECT w.week_start::date AS week_start, COALESCE(c.total_notifications, 0) AS total_notifications, COALESCE(c.weekend_notifications, 0) AS weekend_notifications FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.week_start = w.week_start ORDER BY w.week_start;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(SUM(wt.amount), 0) AS total_transaction_amount FROM consumer_div.wallet_transactions_daily AS wt JOIN consumer_div.users AS u ON u.uid = wt.sender_id WHERE u.country = 'US' AND wt.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' AND wt.created_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day';

WITH merchant_monthly_coupons AS (SELECT m.mid AS merchant_id, m.name, DATE_TRUNC('month', m.created_at) AS created_month, COUNT(c.cid) AS coupon_count FROM consumer_div.merchants m LEFT JOIN consumer_div.coupons c ON c.merchant_id = m.mid AND DATE_TRUNC('month', c.created_at) = DATE_TRUNC('month', m.created_at) GROUP BY m.mid, m.name, DATE_TRUNC('month', m.created_at)), ranked AS (SELECT merchant_id, name, coupon_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY coupon_count DESC) AS rank FROM merchant_monthly_coupons) SELECT merchant_id, name, coupon_count FROM ranked WHERE rank = 1;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', t.created_at)::date AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT t.sender_id) AS pmdau FROM consumer_div.wallet_transactions_daily AS t WHERE t.sender_type = 0 AND t.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '2 months' AND t.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', t.created_at) ORDER BY month;

SELECT u.username, COUNT(n.id) AS unread_promotional_notifications
FROM consumer_div.users AS u
JOIN consumer_div.notifications AS n ON n.user_id = u.uid
WHERE LOWER(u.country) = 'us'
  AND n.type = 'promotional'
  AND n.status = 'unread'
GROUP BY u.uid, u.username
ORDER BY unread_promotional_notifications DESC, u.username;

SELECT m.name AS merchant_name, COUNT(c.cid) AS total_coupons_issued
FROM consumer_div.merchants AS m
JOIN consumer_div.coupons AS c ON c.merchant_id = m.mid
WHERE LOWER(m.status) = 'active'
  AND LOWER(m.category) LIKE '%retail%'
GROUP BY m.mid, m.name
ORDER BY total_coupons_issued DESC, merchant_name;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS tuc FROM consumer_div.user_sessions WHERE session_start_ts >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 month' AND session_start_ts <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
SELECT AVG(balance) AS average_amb FROM consumer_div.wallet_user_balance_daily WHERE updated_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days';

SELECT m.name AS merchant_name, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT wt.coupon_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT wt.txid), 0), 0) AS cpur FROM consumer_div.merchants AS m LEFT JOIN consumer_div.wallet_transactions_daily AS wt ON wt.receiver_id = m.mid AND wt.status = 'successful' GROUP BY m.mid, m.name ORDER BY m.name;

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) = 'successful')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS str FROM consumer_div.wallet_transactions_daily WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND created_at < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE);
